item.title: Accounting
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Accounting Software

Bring on Better Accounting Software

Explore our accounting software, reporting, and budgeting tools for mission-driven organizations.

Speak with an expert

Helping thousands of nonprofits, associations, and municipalities account for their futures.

Grow your mission with MIP Accounting.

Accounting software that simplifies finances and delivers results

Handle intricate financial processes and support finance operations to boost efficiency while keeping data secure and accessible 24/7. Manage your finances. Track every fund. Follow every dollar.

Meet MIP

Connect more. Manage more. Expect more.

Built with 40+ years' experience serving purpose-driven organizations, MIP saves time, boosts engagement, and  maximizes missions.

Helping organizations build better

0+

Mission-driven organizations rely on MIP’s accounting software

0%

Faster task performance and completion of core accounting tasks

Our Solutions

Accounting software that fits your organization

Employ a suite of solutions that empowers organizations to do more, increases financial visibility, and creates operational success. Meet the tools that fit your organization:

Whitepaper

Go-to Guide for Mission-driven Accounting

Set your finance and accounting teams up for success and learn best practices to optimize your organization’s finances and create sustainable success all year long.

Download now

A true partner for your organization

From implementation, to support and training, Momentive is a true partner for your organization.

Implementation Services

Partnering with your organization, the Momentive Client Services Team brings a combined 60+ years of MIP Accounting expertise and over 200 years of collective accounting experience. We’ll guide you through every step.

Learn more

Support Services

With nearly 200 years of combined experience, our MIP Accounting Customer Support team is your trusted partner, ready to provide expert assistance whenever you need it. 

Learn more

Training and Development

Continue to grow with MIP through our in-person, online, and trainer-led classes designed to help you and your team upskill and master the software.

Learn more

FAQ

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Simplify financial management and ensure compliance with MIP Accounting.
Power your mission with better accounting

With MIP Fund Accounting, your organization can simplify operations, ensure compliance, and focus on what matters most: funding and achieving your mission. If you’re ready to explore the platform or want to speak with an expert, we’re here to help you get started.

a:5:{s:6:"item-0";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:72:"What makes MIP Fund Accounting different from other accounting software?";s:6:"answer";s:215:"MIP is purpose-built for nonprofits, governments, and associations. It provides unlimited fund tracking, compliance-focused tools, and customizable reporting to meet the unique needs of mission-driven organizations.";}s:6:"item-1";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:57:"Can MIP Fund Accounting integrate with my existing tools?";s:6:"answer";s:173:"Yes, MIP integrates seamlessly with CRMs, HR platforms, donor management systems, and fundraising tools such as GiveSmart. This ensures smooth data flow across your systems.";}s:6:"item-2";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:70:"Does MIP support compliance with nonprofit and government regulations?";s:6:"answer";s:128:"Absolutely. Connected systems, unified data, better decisions

MIP Fund Accounting connects effortlessly with the tools you already use, ensuring consistent data flow and simplified operations. Whether it’s your GiveSmart Fundraising & Events, CRM, HR, or financial systems, MIP provides seamless integration to unify your processes and deliver a comprehensive view of your organization’s financial health.

item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Learning Management System

Learning Management Systems for Growth & Engagement

Create learning experiences for your organization that are engaging and easy to manage at any scale.

Speak with an expert

Trusted by organizations to power continuing education

Choose the leading learning management software trusted by hundreds of associations  and nonprofits.

Education that moves the needle

Associations pour resources into learning programs with mixed results. Our purpose-built learning technology ensures your educational content drives real career advancement, deeper engagement, and measurable revenue growth—with less work for your staff.

Explore Path LMS

What You Get

Learning technology that drives your mission forward

Transform your association's education from a cost center into your most powerful asset with learning software that advances careers, deepens community connections, generates sustainable revenue, and positions you as the definitive industry leader.

Powering proven results that increase efficiency and impact

0M+

Learners supported

0M+

Credits awarded

0M+

Certificates earned

Features

Get to know the all-in-one LMS built for associations

Path LMS gives you everything you need to create, manage, and grow your learning programs. Discover the tools that make it all possible.

Less manual work, more focus on learning

Connect your LMS with your AMS, community, and other essential business tools to create a unified, efficient ecosystem. Automate data flows between systems and free up your team to focus on what drives real results—creating engaging learning experiences that grow your organization. 

Explore Path LMS Integrations

Your partner in learning from day one

Get additional cost-effective support to grow your learning programs—without increasing your headcount.

Learning Strategy & Content

Our team of instructional design experts transforms your educational vision into engaging content to captivate learners and achieve your goals.

Read more

Virtual Event Management & Production

From planning to production, we create professional virtual events that extend your reach and create memorable experiences for attendees.

Read more

Case Study

How a Top CME Provider Expanded Reach and Revenue with Path LMS

Find out how the United States & Canadian Academy of Pathology grew its user base by 153% and tripled revenue from educational offerings using Path LMS.

Download now

FAQ

Propel your mission and vision forward

Discover how Momentive's solutions can help your organization achieve its goals.

Request a Demo
Speak With Us

item.title: Event Registration
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Event Registration Software

Event Registration Software for Seamless Sign-Ups

Momentive Software's event registration software empowers your team to kick off every event with the best first impression — for conferences, galas, trade shows, and everything in between.

Get started

benefits

Simplify the event registration process for everyone.

Collect and manage attendee sign-ups with ease while delivering a seamless registration experience.

features

Event registration software designed to fit your needs

From personalized sign-up flows to real-time attendee data, get the tools to manage registration from start to finish.

Personalized Registration Experiences

Customized registration for every event type

A tailored registration experience reduces confusion, speeds up sign-ups, and sets the tone for a polished, professional event. Create a personalized registration experience including custom branding with your logo and organization colors. Connect your existing AMS (Association Management System) and CRM (Customer Relationship Management) systems to offer single sign-on and personalized discounts, so returning members move through registration faster. Whether you're running an annual conference, a virtual workshop, or a hybrid summit that serves both on-site and remote attendees, the same registration platform handles it all.

Multiple Registration Options

Drive attendance with flexible registration options

Support multiple ticket types and pricing tiers — early-bird rates, group packages, member discounts, and add-ons — all within a single registration workflow. Capture interest from future attendees, sponsors, and exhibitors with an event inquiry page you can keep active during and after your event. Easily collect attendee data to stay on top of logistics, budget planning, and post-event follow-up.

Mobile Responsiveness

Effective registration for any device, anywhere

With over 50% of web browsing done on mobile devices, your registration page needs to work flawlessly on any screen. Momentive Software's mobile-responsive online registration tool gives attendees a simple, intuitive sign-up experience whether they're on a phone, tablet, or desktop. A seamless mobile experience means fewer drop-offs, fewer support requests, and more completed registrations. Attendees can register, pay, and receive confirmation without friction — from anywhere, on any device.

Multi-Ticket Types and Pricing Tiers

Maximize registration revenue with the right pricing for every attendee

Not every attendee should see the same price — and with Momentive, they don't have to. Create distinct ticket types and pricing tiers that reflect the real complexity of your event: member versus non-member rates, early-bird windows, VIP packages, session add-ons, and more. Tiered pricing incentivizes early registration, helps you hit revenue targets, and gives attendees the flexibility to choose what's right for them. All pricing rules are managed in one place, giving your team full visibility and control without manual workarounds.

Customizable Email Confirmations

Send confirmation emails that reflect your brand and keep attendees informed

Registration doesn't end at the submit button; it continues with every communication your attendees receive afterward. Momentive's event registration software lets you customize confirmation emails with your organization's branding, event-specific details, and the information each attendee type actually needs. Send different confirmation content to speakers, exhibitors, and general attendees automatically, without manual sorting or separate email tools. Branded, accurate confirmations reduce inbound questions from attendees and reinforce the professional first impression your registration page already set.

Real-Time Membership Verification and Onsite Integration

Connect event registration to check-in for a seamless attendee journey

Registration doesn't end when an attendee hits submit — it connects directly to what happens on event day. Momentive Software's event registration software verifies membership status in real time during sign-up, ensuring attendees receive the correct pricing without manual review by your team. Registration data flows directly into onsite check-in and self-service badging, eliminating the need to migrate data to a separate system before your event. Keeping registration open right up to event day becomes lucrative when your registration and onsite tools work together.

Attendee Portal

Empower attendees through self-service

Save your staff time by giving attendees a dedicated self-service portal to manage their own event experience. Attendees can view their event confirmation, print receipts, update their profile, and access FAQs — all without contacting your team. Reducing inbound support requests before and during your event frees your staff to focus on delivering a great experience rather than answering routine questions. The portal keeps attendees informed and in control from registration through event day.

FEATURES OVERVIEW

Get more out of Momentive Event Management, Momentive’s event registration software.

  • Multi-ticket types and price tiers
  • Customizable email confirmations
  • Event registration website design and branding
  • Mobile responsiveness
  • Analytics and reporting
  • Integration for easy onsite self-registration or badges
  • Real-time membership verification
  • Quick, secure credit card processing
  • Self-service portal and event inquiry page

item.title: Check-in and Badging
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Event Check-In Software

Efficient onsite check-in and badge printing

Get started

benefits

A smooth contactless check-in with even smoother events

Easily collect and manage event registrations while providing a user-friendly registration platform for your attendees.

features

Never miss a chance for a great first impression.

Say goodbye to mail merges, many hours spent pre-printing badges, and long check-in lines at your event. Get attendees on their way through two different options for check-in: standard check-in via an attendee lookup or contactless through a barcode scan.

REAL-TIME BADGE PRINTING

Onsite hardware without the hassle

Don’t fret with shipping and setting up printers on site when you have bigger problems to tackle. Our team of experts brings in exactly what’s needed and can be onsite to support your check-in needs.

INTEGRATE EASILY

Compatible with your database

Our badge printing solution integrates with other registration providers, including all major CRM and AMS databases, to give you ultimate flexibility. Rest easy knowing you can quickly and easily leverage registration data for your real-time badge printing on site.

BADGE OPTIONS

Your badge, your way

Print high-quality, color badges from your AMS, CRM, or event management system in seconds.

ADVANCED REPORTING

Get real-time, actionable insights

Access live reporting to see when attendees check-in across various days of your event by attendee type, location, and more.

FEATURES OVERVIEW

Get more out of your event check-in.

  • Real-time badge printing
  • Advanced segmentation and reporting
  • Several badge styles
  • Design, set-up, and admin of registration
  • Email confirmations for attendees
  • Badge advertisements and sponsorships
  • Integration with registration and AMS/CRM
  • Mobile device check-in
  • 24/7 live registration

request a demo

Momentive's event solutions are built to minimize your pre-planning workload and save your staff time. If you’re ready to explore or want to speak with an expert, we’re here to help you get started.

item.title: Event Apps
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Event App

Turn your events into immersive experiences

Amplify the attendee experience with a personalized mobile app experience. Whether you’re planning a conference or tradeshow, lean on Momentive Software’s event apps to meet your needs and wow your attendees.

Get started

Features

Bring your events to life and boost attendee engagement.

Optimize the event experience for attendees and staff with powerful features and capabilities.

Build community through networking and engagement.

Help attendees make valuable connections and meet the right people before, during, and after the event with networking tools like 1:1 connections, messages, meetings, and matchmaking. With permission-based connections, attendees are in control of their experience. Keep your attendees updated and engaged with content, exhibitors, and activities through push notifications, social media feed, surveys, and polls.

Create one-of-a-kind, personalized experiences.

Empower attendees to create their own agendas to fit their interests. Registrants can sort sessions by date and time and can easily add sessions and activities to their personal schedule. The next upcoming item is always available on the dashboard for an attendee to easily remember where they need to be next.

Drive sponsorship revenue  & ROI.

Maximize your sponsors’ ROI with a variety of sponsor highlights, including sponsor lists, exhibitor profiles, ads, push notifications, and more. Monetize and underwrite the cost of your event app by selling sponsorship perks like push notifications or banner ads to your exhibitors and industry partners.

Offer attendees interactive navigation tools.

Ensure your attendees always know where to be with interactive floor plans and maps that help them get to their next session, upcoming meeting, or a must-see exhibitor. Attendees can get the best path routing booth-to-booth, to and from session rooms, and more.

Monitor event performance.

Use a robust stats portal for all your app analytics—from attendee engagement to post-event survey feedback—to measure your event’s success. Post-event analytics will help you make informed decisions for your next event, leverage engagement data to personalize your outreach efforts, and convert first-time attendees into returning attendees.

What You Get

Ensure all your event essentials are covered.

Our solutions simplify every step of the event process so you can focus on delivering unforgettable experiences for your attendees.

Get started

Request a Demo

Create meaningful event experiences

Momentive’s event solutions are built to minimize your pre-planning workload and save your staff time. If you’re ready to explore or want to speak with an expert, we’re here to help you get started.

Explore more event management solutions

item.title: Attendee Tracking
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Attendee Tracking Software

Measure event success with event tracking

Learn how attendees move through sessions using advanced tracking technology, quickly scan badges on-site for session check-in, discover how session content resonates with different attendee types, and accurately award CEUs.

Get started

Benefits

Get one-of-a-kind metrics per attendee.

Easily manage access to sessions down to the individual attendee. Measure and award CEUs based on sessions attended and how long an attendee stays in a session.

features

Gain deeper insight into your events.

Attendee tracking technology allows you to scan event badges to see how long attendees stay in sessions and how they move throughout your event.

TRACK ATTENDANCE

Truly understand your attendees’ behavior.

Monitor where attendees go during your meeting and how long they stay in sessions. Uncover popular topics and content by attendee type or demographics, and use this information to plan a better event next year.

AWARD CREDITS

Accurately award your attendees.

Avoid errors with sign-in sheets and self-reporting by using session scanning apps. Scan attendees in and out of sessions to verify they stayed for the required time, and then easily award credit after your event.

MANAGE SESSION ATTENDANCE

Manage session attendance.

Keep unregistered attendees from accessing your meeting or restricted sessions that require an additional fee with our badge scanning app.

ANALYTICS AND REPORTING

Uncover powerful event data.

With our attendee tracking dashboard, import attendee metrics to follow when an attendee checked into a session or area, when they were checked out, and how long they attended.

FEATURES OVERVIEW

Get more out of your event with attendee tracking.

  • Attendance verification
  • Award CE credit
  • Plan future sessions based on analytics
  • Access custom attendee metrics
  • Hand-held scanning apps
  • Track heavily attended topics
  • Eliminate sign-in sheets
  • Track attendee behavior
  • Monitor event movement

request a demo

Create meaningful event experiences

Momentive's event solutions are built to minimize your pre-planning workload and save your staff time. If you’re ready to explore or want to speak with an expert, we’re here to help you get started.

Explore more event management solutions

item.title: Lead Capture
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Lead Capture Software

Maximize exhibitor ROI with innovative lead capture solutions

Provide your exhibitors with advanced lead capture solutions that help them increase opportunities and connect with more attendees.

Get started

Benefits

More exhibitor leads, more value for your sponsors

Keep sponsors and exhibitors coming back by helping them prove the ROI of your event with industry-leading lead capture.

features

Deliver impressive lead capture solutions and technology.

Allow exhibitors to digitally collect contact information and generate leads at your event with our software solutions.

MULTIPLE LEAD CAPTURE SOLUTIONS

Pick options that meet your unique needs.

Allow exhibitors to digitally collect contact information and generate leads at your event using one of our solutions.

REAL-TIME REGISTRATION DATA

Gain deeper insights, immediately.

Lead information is synced automatically to provide real-time registration data and contact information at your event.

ACCESS LEADS ONLINE

Digitally secure your lead info.

Leads are synced to a password-protected online portal where exhibitors can view or download their lead information.

CREATE CUSTOM SURVEYS

Enable sponsors to customize qualification.

Build custom surveys to qualify leads as they are collected, and create multiple surveys with different criteria.

ADD NOTES TO SCANNED LEADS

Keep notes collaborative and organized.

Physically write notes for each lead or add them directly to the lead record when using our mobile app solution.

FOLLOW UP WITH LEADS IMMEDIATELY

Build relationships ASAP.

features

benefits

item.title: Abstract Management
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Abstract Management Software

Enjoy Painless Management of Abstract Submissions

Eliminate the headache of sorting through hundreds of submissions. Collect session and abstract submissions, review submission content, and organize and accept on the spot through one intuitive portal.

Get started

Benefits

Create, submit, review, repeat – the easy way.

Seamlessly track your session and abstract submission and review process in one dynamic platform.

Get started

Features

Make your next call for sessions the simplest yet

Simplify the process for all stakeholders with a powerful tool that allows you to seamlessly collect and manage submissions.

Submission

Collect content on the spot.

Customize your submission process and gather the information you need to make informed decisions, with a simple and customizable step-by-step interface.

  • Build a submission process that highlights all the specific criteria that are important to your organization
  • Invite speakers to submit sessions and abstracts
  • Set rules by submission types and create different requirements for each
  • Add as many or as few requirements and fields as you want
  • Link to required forms or documents
  • Handle payments for any of your submissions

Review

Keep everyone on the same page.

Optimize collaboration and stay organized with review features that delight reviewers and keep everything on track.

  • Assign different roles to reviewers based on submission type
  • Give your reviewers access to their own portal where they can easily view and manage submissions
  • Track the status of reviewers and send email reminders with a few clicks
  • Automatically compile comments and calculate average scores, and give reviewers the ability to track their overall grading results
  • Partner with a designated project manager who will work with you to assign users and category/types

DECIDE, COMMUNICATE, AND REPORT

Make the right decision, faster.

Access all the data you need to make a decision, keep all stakeholders informed, and notify submitters with automated, personalized email notifications. Leverage powerful and customizable reporting tools that integrate with other software to get a simple view of complex data in one spot.

Features Overview

Simplify the process with powerful and intuitive tools.

Submission

  • Invite participants to submit
  • Handle payments
  • Link to required forms or documents
  • Make your requirements simple or complex
  • Set rules by submission type

Review

  • Allow for multiple rounds of review
  • Update and change assignments
  • Blind or double-blind eligible proposals
  • Rate, comment, and approve proposals
  • Track conflict of interest

Decide, Communicate, and Report

  • Review all your data in one central location
  • Make decisions with ease
  • Keep everyone informed
  • Send automated and personalized notifications
  • Run powerful reports

Testimonials

Request a Demo

Create meaningful event experiences

Momentive’s event solutions are built to minimize your pre-planning workload and save your staff time. If you’re ready to explore or want to speak with an expert, we’re here to help you get started.

Explore more event management solutions

View All

Power your mission with better accounting

With MIP Fund Accounting, your organization can simplify operations, ensure compliance, and focus on what matters most: funding and achieving your mission. If you’re ready to explore the platform or want to speak with an expert, we’re here to help you get started.
Empowering organizations with results that matter
Organizations across the nonprofit, government, and association sectors trust MIP Fund Accounting to simplify their financial operations and deliver measurable results.

MIP Fund Accounting delivers scalable, compliant financial tools designed to meet the unique needs of nonprofits, governments, and associations. From managing multi-fund accounting and automating accounting workflows to ensuring compliance and improving reporting, MIP empowers mission-driven organizations to simplify operations and achieve their goals.

item.title: CE Credit Claiming
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
CE Management

Top-of-class CE credit claiming solutions to meet your needs

Promote attendee learning with our convenient and reliable CE credit claiming solution.

Get started

features

Smarter ways to boost attendee learning

Leverage software designed to streamline your CE credit claiming process across the entire attendee lifecycle.

ENDURING MATERIALS

Provide CME activity on your watch.

Easily share content online and create a new revenue stream with enduring materials, self-assessment, and/or self-directed learning activities.

EXTERNAL CERTIFICATE COLLECTION

Keep your credentials together.

Allow attendees to upload their credits from other sources so they can view all their credits in one place.

CUSTOM EVALUATIONS OR SURVEY BUILDING

Build intuitive forms.

Create session-specific evaluations using forms with custom question and answer types for specific sessions, full courses, or even claiming.

REPORTING AND METRICS

Run robust reports.

Create attendee reports to track awarded credits to show specific users credits and the participation of an entire session or course, and more.

FEATURES OVERVIEW

CE credit claiming software that keeps learners engaged

  • Board issuance reporting
  • Activity-specific certificate statement capabilities
  • Attendee/user credit claiming
  • License issuance reporting
  • Accreditation bodies collection

benefits

Tech that goes beyond the classroom

Access tools that help support your CE credit claiming efforts and increase non-dues revenue.

Fast credit claiming

Attendees can quickly claim, view, and manage their continuing education credits by logging into the platform and locating their event.

Customizable materials

Event administrators can create overall course evaluations or session specific evaluations to promote attendee learning.

Personalized web portal

Users have access to their own intuitive web portal to claim continuing education credits, take pre/post-tests, manage enduring materials, and more.

request a demo

Create meaningful event experiences

Momentive's event solutions are built to minimize your pre-planning workload and save your staff time. If you’re ready to explore or want to speak with an expert, we’re here to help you get started.

Explore more event management solutions

item.title: AI-Powered Learning
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
AI LMS

Ignite learning creation with AI

Your organization’s expertise drives great learning programs. AI just makes you faster at creating them. Generate content, build assessments, and visualize data in minutes instead of hours while maintaining the quality and standards your members expect. 

Experience AI in Path LMS 

benefits

AI that amplifies your expertise without replacing it

Artificial intelligence (AI) should enrich, not replace, the learning experience. That's why AI features in Path LMS are designed to deepen learner engagement, optimize and expand content creation, and empower data-driven strategy. 

features

Next-generation AI tools for forward-thinking organizations

Path LMS AI features tackle the manual tasks that slow you down, delivering finished course materials and insights in minutes.

AI-POWERED CONTENT GENERATION

Skip the blank page with intelligent content creation

Generate course descriptions, refine existing materials, and create relevant images to support your learning objectives. AI helps you get past the blank page and develop industry-relevant content that expands your learning library efficiently.

AI-POWERED ASSESSMENTS & KNOWLEDGE CHECKS

Generate relevant quiz questions in minutes

Automatically generate assessment questions from your existing course content and create knowledge checks that keep learners engaged. AI suggests relevant assessment questions and inserts interactive prompts directly into course materials to reinforce key concepts.

AI-POWERED DATA VISUALIZATION

Visual insights without the manual work

Transform your learning analytics into clear, actionable insights. Generate data visualizations and reports in Path LMS on demand, without any manual charting or aggregation work required.

request a demo

Engaging learning starts with Path LMS

Join hundreds of associations and non-profits using Path LMS to design custom education programs on an easy-to-use learning management system.

Explore more learning management solutions

item.title: Learner Engagement
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Learning Engagement Tool

Keep learners invested with engaging experiences

Great content deserves a great learning experience. Path LMS delivers intuitive, accessible, and fully branded learning environments that engage every learner—from the first login to course completion and beyond.

Get started

Benefits

Connect. Communicate. Inspire.

Path LMS puts learner engagement at the center of everything, combining intuitive design, accessibility, and seamless branding to create a learning environment that your audience will return to time and again.

Get started

Features

Engaging features to help learners advance their careers

Every interaction matters when it comes to learner success. Path LMS combines powerful customization, seamless communication, and inclusive design to create learning environments where engagement happens naturally.

Social Learning

Foster connection and collaboration

Discussions, peer feedback, and social interactions keep learners engaged beyond individual courses. Create tailored surveys to collect learner feedback and better understand your audience.

Live Events

Maximize learner engagement and accessibility

Reach all learners and expand your audience by offering webinars, hybrid experiences, and live streamed events, increasing program accessibility and boosting learning engagement.

Notifications & Reminders

Keep learners informed and engaged automatically

Automated, customizable notifications and reminders keep learners on track. Comprehensive system notifications handle everything from event registrations to transaction alerts without manual intervention.

Multi-language Support

Serve learners in their preferred language

Support multiple languages including Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, and more. Learners can set language preferences while maintaining consistent branding and functionality across all localized experiences.

Learning without barriers

We believe in inclusive learning, and our accessibility features work seamlessly behind the scenes to support every member of your learning community. Path LMS breaks down learning barriers by making education accessible to all learners.

Path LMS meets rigorous accessibility standards (Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 Level AA) to ensure every user can easily engage with your content. With built-in features like automatic video captioning, screen reader compatibility, and keyboard navigation, Path LMS empowers all your learners to succeed.

Request our VPAT

Features Overview

Get more from your learning management system

  • Custom domains, branding, and white-label platform options
  • Automated email notifications and completion reminders
  • Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility compliance
  • Customizable home pages and landing pages
  • Customizable email templates and email address
  • Learner surveys and feedback collection tools
  • Discussion forums with moderation tools and instructor feedback
  • Multi-language platform support including Chinese, Spanish, French, and more
  • User profile customization

Request a Demo

Engaging learning starts with Path LMS

Join hundreds of associations and non-profits using Path LMS to design custom education programs on an easy-to-use learning management system.

Explore more LMS features

item.title: Course Creation
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Course Creation Software

Create courses to engage your learners and advance their careers

Education is at the heart of your association’s mission. Choose user-friendly course creation tools to save staff time, enhance content engagement, and deliver a professional learning experience.

Get started

Benefits

Easy to build courses that pack a powerful learning experience

From flexible content formats to streamlined content creation tools, Path LMS helps you create courses that engage members, meet compliance standards, and grow with your  organization's needs.

Get started

Features

Build courses that work for associations

Creating effective online learning shouldn’t take forever or require advanced technical skills. Path LMS gives you intuitive tools and flexible options to quickly build courses that guide learners toward their goals, with easy administrative controls that let you focus on great content instead of complicated setup.

DRAG-AND-DROP COURSE BUILDER

Create and manage courses with ease

Design custom learning paths by simply dragging course content where you want it, from webinars and on-demand videos to assessments and certificates. No coding skills required—just point, click, and build engaging courses that guide learners to achieving their goals.

Branded Portal

Make your content stand out and reflect your brand

Fully control the look and feel of your courses in Path LMS with a no-code editing tool. Add images, format text, customize layouts, and create reusable templates and components to leverage across multiple courses.

AI-CONTENT CREATION

Skip the blank page and generate course materials in minutes

Save hours of content development time with built-in AI content generation tools. Use simple prompts to create course descriptions, learning outcomes, images, and more so you can focus on delivering valuable member experiences.

Flexible Content Delivery

Deliver learning that supports your audience and organization

Offer content in multiple formats—from self-paced videos and downloadable resources to interactive presentations and mobile-friendly modules. Easily update and manage your content in Path LMS over time while giving your members the flexibility to learn how, when, and where it works best for their professional demands and learning preferences.

Features

Get more from your learning management system

  • Multi-media content support (audio, video, slides, and more)
  • Video playback controls
  • Reusable templates and dynamic components
  • AI-powered video captions and transcripts
  • SCORM compliance and standards support
  • Course completion prerequisites
  • Dynamic and featured course content
  • Course metadata, tagging, and categorization
  • Granular course publishing and access states

Need support creating engaging content for your learners?

We’re here to help. Explore our end-to-end Learning & Development services.

Learn more

Request a Demo

Engaging learning starts with Path LMS

Join hundreds of associations and non-profits using Path LMS to design custom education programs on an easy-to-use learning management system.

Explore more LMS features

item.title: Live Events
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
LMS Events

Host virtual learning events to connect your members and grow your association

Live events are where your audience comes together to learn and network. Deliver professional webinars, meetings, conferences, and hybrid experiences to keep members engaged and coming back.

Get started

Benefits

Easy and manageable events, with an engaging experience

From registration to post-event follow-up, Path LMS helps you deliver professional webinars and live streaming events that build community, showcase expertise, and provide measurable ROI for your organization.

Features

Deliver live events without compromising on results

Whether you prefer using an integrated webinar platform or want complete control with custom live streaming, Path LMS gives you the flexibility to deliver event experiences that work for your staff and wow your learners.

INTEGRATED WEBINAR PLATFORMS

Connect with your existing webinar tools

Easily self-host live events using Zoom, GoToWebinar, GoToMeeting, or Adobe Connect. Integrated registration automatically syncs attendee data and handles the technical handoff so you can focus on content.

BUILT-IN LIVE STREAMING

Deliver immersive events with professional-grade features

Use our live streaming services with a customizable event player for when you need full control. Add attendance verification prompts, live chat, Q&A, polling, and real-time announcements for interactive experiences.

STREAMLINED REGISTRATION MANAGEMENT

Manage attendees without the administrative burden

Create custom registration pages with speaker bios, event descriptions, and resources. Send automated confirmation and reminder emails, track attendance with detailed reports, and manage everything from one dashboard.

Features

Get more from your learning management system

  • Multi-language AI captions, subtitles, and audio dubbing*
  • Attendance verification prompts*
  • Customizable confirmation and reminder email notifications
  • Custom branded live stream layouts and lower thirds*
  • In-person event registration
  • Minimum attendance duration requirements*
  • Registrant and attendee reporting

*Available for Path LMS live stream events.

Need support for your virtual events?

Power Path LMS virtual events your way—from self-managed tools to full-service production. Our managed virtual event services are available to support your staff to deliver captivating webinars, live streams, and hybrid events.

Learn more

request a demo

Engaging learning starts with Path LMS

Join hundreds of associations and non-profits using Path LMS to design custom education programs on an easy-to-use learning management system.

item.title: Credits and Certificates
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Credentialing Software

Transform Course Completions into Career Advancement

When learners finish courses, reward their hard-earned efforts, while automating the entire process. Offer certificates for resumes and credit completion for credentialing bodies.

Get started

Benefits

Less admin work for you, more career value for learners

Momentive Credentialing Software simplifies how your organization acknowledges achievement and tracks professional development. Automated systems handle everything from credit calculation to certificate generation with accuracy and professionalism.

Features

Handle any type of credit, certificate, or credential without the headache

Whether you need simple completion certificates or complex credentialing tracking, Momentive Credentialing Software gives you the flexibility to set up exactly what your learners need while keeping the administrative work to a minimum.

CREDIT TRACKING

From basic completion to complex credentialing requirements

Create unlimited custom credit types with granular completion rules that fit your specific needs. Award partial credit, handle self-attestation, and maintain detailed certificate transcripts that learners can access anytime.

CUSTOM CERTIFICATE BUILDER

Create professional certificates without a designer

Build beautiful certificate templates in minutes using our visual editor. Add custom fields, logos, and signatures. Generate high-quality PDFs automatically or let learners download them when they’re ready.

DIGITAL BADGES

Expand recognition beyond certificates and credentials

Our multiple digital badging integrations help you provide learners with different badging, credentialing, and testing options. Automatically award digital badges based on participation or achievement.

Features Overview

Get more from your credentialing software

  • Customizable credit types you can edit and manage as needed
  • High-quality PDF certificates with dynamic fields
  • Reusable certificate templates across multiple courses
  • Granular completion rules with partial credit options
  • Certificate transcripts that learners can access anytime
  • Digital badging integrations with automatic triggers
  • Custom certificate fields and metadata for specific requirements
  • Self-attestation for external learning activities
  • Credit writeback integrations with AMS, CRM, and other third-party system

Focus on education, not technical complexity

Momentive Credentialing Software Connects directly with major reporting systems, automatically syncing credit data and eliminating manual work.

FAQs

request a demo

Do more with your credentialing software system

Join hundreds of associations, nonprofits, and organizations using Momentive Credentialing Software to design custom education programs on an easy-to-use platform.

Explore more certification management solutions

item.title: Reporting and Analytics
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
LMS Analytics

Uncover the story behind your learning data

You don't have to be a data scientist to get valuable insights from your learning management system. Intuitive reporting and analytics tools in Path LMS empower you to make data-driven decisions that drive your association's learning programs forward.

Get started

Benefits

Transform data into organizational strategy

Get the insights you need to optimize courses, track learner progress, and demonstrate program value with intuitive analytics and reporting to save time while driving better educational outcomes.

Features

Build reports that matter to your organization

Cookie-cutter reporting tools don't capture what makes your learning programs successful or meaningful. With Path LMS, you can craft compelling data stories tailored to your goals and easily build, modify, and share custom reports that provide essential insights to your key stakeholders.

INTUITIVE DASHBOARDS

Stay up-to-date with live, interactive data at your fingertips

Apply filters, adjust date ranges, and drill into underlying metrics with just a few clicks. Track learning engagement, completion rates, and revenue performance through dedicated dashboards that make complex data simple to understand.

CUSTOM REPORT BUILDER

Build the exact reports you need with flexible, self-service tools

The power of data storytelling is in your hands with the Path LMS Report Builder. Easily create custom reports featuring multiple views, tailored to meet your specific data analysis needs and preferences.

AI-POWERED DATA VISUALIZATION

Transform raw data into clear insights instantly with AI

Get the clarity you need to make informed decisions in seconds. Simply describe what you want to see, and Path LMS AI generates professional visualizations that illuminate trends and patterns.

REPORTING API

Integrate your LMS data seamlessly

Connect your learning data directly with existing business intelligence tools using the Path LMS Reporting API. Access precise data when you need it and integrate insights into your broader analytics workflow for streamlined internal reporting.

item.title: E-Commerce
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Ecommerce LMS

Expand revenue beyond membership dues

Transform educational content into thriving revenue streams. Build sustainable non-dues revenue from your courses, certifications, and training programs with easy-to-use e-commerce tools in Path LMS.

Get started

Benefits

Flexible commerce options that fit your organization

Whether you prefer our built-in shopping cart or need to integrate with your existing AMS, Path LMS adapts to your operational needs while maximizing revenue potential.

Features

Smart pricing tools to drive revenue and member value

Path LMS helps you take control of pricing to boost sales and member satisfaction. Leverage smart tools to maximize revenue while honoring the unique value of your association’s membership.

FLEXIBLE PRICING OPTIONS

Build special offers to maximize sales

Create compelling offers with product bundles, discounts, promotional codes, and limited time pricing. Set expiration dates for special offers and manage complex pricing scenarios that drive sales and increase average order value.

MEMBER & GROUP PRICING

Target pricing to your unique audiences

Specify member, non-member, and special group access for all your content with Path LMS. Sync your association management system (AMS) to create a smooth experience without compromising tiered access or organizational pricing structures.

FEATURES OVERVIEW

Get more from your learning management system

  • Built-in shopping cart with streamlined checkout process
  • Member and non-member pricing

item.title: Quizzes and Assessments
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Quiz and Assessment Tools

Measure learner understanding with flexible quiz and assessment tools

Go beyond course completions to truly measure learning outcomes. Create comprehensive assessments that validate knowledge and provide meaningful feedback, while reducing the burden of manual tracking.

Get started

Benefits

Powerful assessment tools to save time and improve learning outcomes

Path LMS assessment features help you create meaningful evaluations that actually measure understanding while automating the tedious work of grading, feedback, and result management.

Features

Comprehensive assessment tools for every learning scenario

From quick knowledge checks to comprehensive evaluations, Path LMS provides the flexibility to measure learning effectively while keeping administrative work minimal.

AI-POWERED QUESTION GENERATION

Create relevant questions faster with AI

Reduce assessment creation time while maintaining quality and relevance with AI-powered tools in Path LMS. Use AI to generate assessment questions from your course content and automatically create knowledge checks that reinforce key concepts.

FLEXIBLE ASSESSMENT CONTROLS

Configure assessments that match your requirements

Handle everything from quick knowledge checks to extensive tests. Set attempt limits, time restrictions, and submission controls. Use question pools for randomized testing, configure pass/fail thresholds, and control when and how learners can access results.

MULTIPLE QUESTION TYPES

Test knowledge in multiple ways

Create engaging assessments with multiple choice, matching questions, matrix questions, and more. Add answer rationales for both correct and incorrect responses and use varied question formats to thoroughly evaluate learner understanding.

FEATURES OVERVIEW

Get more from your learning management system

  • Multiple question types including matching and matrix questions
  • Timed assessments with granular submission controls
  • Question pools and randomization for secure testing
  • Automatic pass/fail notifications and result management
  • Answer rationales for enhanced learning feedback
  • Peer assessment and comparison scoring tools
  • Assignment content upload and submission tracking
  • Assessment attempt rules and retry limitations
  • Comprehensive summary reports and analytics

item.title: Extended Membership
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
External Learning Partnerships

Expand your reach and grow revenue with external learning partnerships

Your educational content has value beyond your current membership. Empower companies, chapters, partners, and other external organizations to sell your learning programs and manage their learners while maintaining complete control over your content.

Get started

Benefits

Empower external organizations while activating new revenue streams

The Path LMS Teams feature helps you sell educational content to external organizations, expand your market reach, and generate non-dues revenue without adding complexity to your operations.

Features

Extend your educational programs beyond your membership

If your association lacks the resources to grow revenue and expand your customer base for your learning programs, Path LMS can help. With the Path LMS Teams feature, your association can easily sell your existing learning content to external organizations.

TEAM MANAGEMENT

Empower partner organizations to manage their own learners

Allow external clients to assign content, manage users, and access detailed reporting for their teams. Set granular permissions to control what each partner can see and do, while you maintain ownership of your educational content and pricing.

TEAM PAGES

Create branded learning portals for each external organization

Build custom landing pages that reflect each external partner’s branding using the intuitive page builder in Path LMS. Add dynamically populated, team-specific content that keeps learning offerings current and relevant for each organization's unique needs.

AUTOMATED USER MANAGEMENT

Streamline access with single sign-on integration

Automatically assign users to Path LMS Teams through SSO functionality that works with popular AMS and CRM platforms. Reduce administrative overhead while providing smooth experiences for partner organizations and their learners.

Case Study

AIHA Saw a 35% Year-Over-Year Revenue Increase Using Path LMS Teams

The American Industrial Hygiene Association uses the Path LMS Teams feature to streamline their eLearning delivery for increased content access, membership, and association revenue.

item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
LMS Consulting

Make the most of your learning content

Your organization has valuable knowledge to share. Our Learning & Development team helps transform your expertise into interactive and impactful educational programs to engage learners and drive real results.

Get started

Benefits

Expert guidance to amplify your educational impact

Every adult’s professional learning journey is unique. Our Path LMS team combines decades of instructional design expertise with a deep understanding of your organization’s goals to create learning experiences that truly resonate with your audience.

Services

Get comprehensive Learning & Development support

From strategic planning to content creation, our team provides end-to-end support to transform your educational vision into reality with measurable results.

STRATEGIC LEARNING CONSULTATION

Develop learning roadmaps that drive results

Work with our strategists through collaborative workshops to maximize existing resources, identify growth opportunities, and create clear learning program objectives with measurable targets and actionable coaching support.

CONTENT TRANSFORMATION SERVICES

Turn expertise into engaging learning experiences

We’ll help you transform in-person training into interactive eLearning, repurpose recorded webinars into engaging courses, translate static curricula into multimedia experiences, and create comprehensive onboarding programs for new professionals.

INSTRUCTIONAL DESIGN EXPERTISE

Learning experiences built on proven principles

Our team applies adult learning theory and instructional design best practices to create learner-centric experiences that keep audiences engaged and deliver measurable impact for your organization.

Case Study

ACSM Leveraged Learning & Development Services to Modernize Learning Offerings

The American College of Sports Medicine’s (ACSM) partnership with Path LMS modernized their educational offerings, launched new revenue-generating courses, and created a strategic roadmap for their 50,000 learners.

item.title: Budgeting and Forecasting Software
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Budget Software

Bring on Better Budget Software

Seamless planning, forecasting, and reporting in the cloud increase financial visibility and allocate more time towards your mission.

Get started

Benefits

Smarter financial planning and forecasting in the cloud

Quickly view your finances with user-friendly budgeting, reporting, payments, grant administration, and more. Share insights that shape your future.

Features

Accessible budgeting for mission-driven organizations

Financial planning and analysis is now easier than ever. Discover the essential accounting functions that empower you to take total control of your organization’s financial future.

General Ledger Management and Reporting

A general ledger that gets your organization

Track financial information in a way that works best for your organization using a truly flexible, segmented chart of accounts that conforms to your organization. Track cash receipts, cash disbursements, journal vouchers, and other financial transactions with an easy-to-use report writer directly within the application.

Accounts Payable featuring Momentive Automated Payments for MIP

Take the hassle out of vendor payments

Say goodbye to manual, time-consuming payment processes with Momentive Automated Payments with Corpay as the payment provider. It seamlessly integrates with your general ledger, giving you a clear, centralized view of all your financial data. You'll spend less time on tedious tasks and more time building strong relationships with your vendors.

Accounts Receivable Reporting with Billing

Get a crystal-clear view of your cash flow

Understand exactly where your money stands. Easily track amounts due and credits, providing detailed or summary reports organized by date, customer, or any other classification you choose. With a few clicks, you can generate an aging report to monitor outstanding balances, helping you forecast cash flow and make smarter financial decisions.

Budget Management

Take control of your budget, today and for the future

Stop guessing and start planning with confidence. Create an unlimited number of customized budgets, even for cross-year projects. You can enforce budget control with a single click, activate warnings to prevent overspending, and create "what if" scenarios to ensure your organization's long-term financial health.

Bank Reconciliation with Automated Bank Feed

Reconcile your accounts  in a flash

Eliminate manual entry and tedious comparisons. Bank Feed automatically matches transactions from your bank, saving you hours of work and reducing the risk of human error. You'll have a clear, up-to-the-minute view of your cash balances, all with minimal effort.

Built-in Reporting

The data you need, whenever you need it

Stop sifting through spreadsheets and get the information you want instantly. Our software features a powerful, built-in report editor with over 150 dynamic report templates. Whether you need a quick overview or a highly detailed analysis, you can customize reports to fit your organization's unique needs. Effortlessly create your own, share them with your team, and build a library of reports to inform every decision you make.

Helping organizations build better

Momentive’s MIP Accounting handles intricate financial processes and supports finance operations to boost efficiency, improve visibility, and bolster operations. Bring on Better for your organization’s finances.

item.title: Financial Management
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Financial Management Software

Bring on Better
Financial Management

Improve your organization’s financial operations and simplify purchasing, fund allocations, encumbrances, and fixed asset tracking with our financial management software.

Get started

Benefits

Accounting for your future made simple

Dive into the details of your operations and keep your organization on track to meet yearly projections and propel your mission forward.

Features

Financial management software that gets your organization

Understand what fuels your organization and manage funds easier. MIP Accounting helps your finance team do more and fund initiatives that move your mission.

Foreign Currency Processing

Manage your global finances with confidence

Operating across different currencies shouldn’t be a headache. Maintain and report on unlimited currencies, rates, and rate types. Easily enter invoices in one currency and pay in another, and automatically generate translated, FAS 52-compliant financial statements. This ensures you always have an accurate, up-to-date view of your finances, and remain in compliance with GAAP standards.

Allocations Management

Streamline your allocations, save time and effort

Stop spending hours on complicated financial allocations. Perform complex, multi-step allocations with a single click, ensuring accuracy and consistency every time. You can even preview the impact of your allocations on your financial reports before they are posted to your General Ledger, giving you the confidence to make smarter decisions.

Electronic Requisitions

Simplify your purchasing and stay on budget

Take control of your pre-purchase decisions and improve efficiency with Electronic Requisitions. Get instant visibility into the financial impact of every request with our one-click budget checking tool ensuring your team can move forward quickly while staying on budget.

Encumbered Funds Management

Gain true visibility into your budget

No more workarounds or manually managing encumbrances. Reserve funds for planned expenditures and commitments, giving you a more accurate picture of your true budget performance. By including encumbrances on your financial reports and in budget-checking tools, you’ll improve tracking, compliance, and your ability to make informed spending decisions.

Purchase Orders

Master your purchasing process from start to finish

Improve the entire purchasing process. Purchase orders are seamlessly integrated with Accounts Payable and Receiving  giving you a complete, end-to-end view of your purchases, helping you improve control, reduce errors, and ensure you’re getting exactly what you ordered.

Fixed Asset Management

Track your assets with unmatched precision

Take the complexity out of managing your fixed assets. Track assets, automatically calculate depreciation, and generate the necessary General Ledger entries for both depreciation and disposal. Easily record new assets directly from Accounts Payable, cash disbursements, or Purchase Orders, saving you time and ensuring your records are always accurate.

Helping organizations build better

0+

Mission-driven organizations rely on MIP’s accounting software

0%

Faster task performance and completion of core accounting tasks

Request a Demo

Account more. Report more. Thrive more.

Momentive’s MIP Accounting handles intricate financial processes and supports finance operations to boost efficiency, improve visibility, and bolster operations. Bring on Better for your organization’s finances.

Explore more fundraising solutions

item.title: Reporting, Mission Intelligence & Insights
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Financial Reporting Software

Bring on Better Financial Reporting Software

From defining how your organization allocates resources to highlighting operations as the year progresses, reporting is crucial for advocating for more resources, soliciting sponsorships and partnerships, and demonstrating how your organization meets its mission.

Get started

Benefits

Reporting software that tells your story

Improving transparency, shoring up compliance, and creating the lateral that informs decision-making, reporting is the heart of mission-driven organizations. With 150-plus built-in reports and a custom report editor, MIP Accounting makes it easy to tell your financial story.

Features

Easy-to-use financial reporting software for mission-driven organizations

Quickly and clearly create board-quality reports and track important financial figures quickly in our all-in-one accounting system.

Dashboards

Get instant visibility into your mission

Don't spend hours searching for the numbers that matter. Our dashboards give you complete, at-a-glance visibility into your organization's financial health. You can stay updated on cash flow, track key metrics, and get the critical insights you need to make confident decisions—all from a single, intuitive screen. 

Forms Designer

Professional documents, designed by you

Ensure every document your organization creates looks professional and reflects your brand. Our Forms Designer lets you customize billing statements, checks, and purchase orders. You can even set up custom preferences, like automatically adding a manager's signature to checks under a certain value, saving you time and ensuring consistency. 

GASB Reporting

Simplify government reporting and stay compliant

Governmental organizations have unique reporting requirements, all the tools you need to easily create reports that are fully compliant with the Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB). This takes the stress out of compliance and helps you maintain public trust.

DrillPoint Reports

Unlock a deeper look into your data

Take your financial analysis to the next level within a familiar spreadsheet environment. As a Microsoft Excel add-in, DrillPoint Reports allows you to drill down into your data all the way to the transaction level. You can use all of Excel's powerful features, like graphs and tables, to create compelling financial reports that tell a clear and powerful story. 

Helping organizations build better

0+

Mission-driven organizations rely on MIP’s accounting software

0%

Faster task performance and completion of core accounting tasks

request a demo

Account more. Report more. Thrive more.

Momentive’s MIP Accounting handles intricate financial processes and supports finance operations to boost efficiency, improve visibility, and bolster operations. Bring on Better for your organization’s finances.

Explore more accounting solutions

View All

item.title: Audit-ready Security and Compliance
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Audit Software

Bring on Better Audit Software

Audits are a powerful tool for building trust and long-term sustainability. Showcase your organization’s commitment to fiscal responsibility, and sleep soundly knowing your data and information are protected and audit-ready.

Get started

Benefits

Compliance. Security. Transparency. Always.

Be audit-ready with MIP Accounting’s robust audit suite. From our built-in audit trail to internal controls and view-only licenses, we give your organization the tools to ace your financial audits.

Features

Helping organizations ace their audit for 40+ years

Easily handle every step of the audit process from pre-work to post-audit with MIP Accounting’s robust audit tools.

Advanced Security and Access Controls

Protect your data and simplify your audit

Safeguard your organization and gain peace of mind with robust security. Our Advanced Security and Access Controls promote accountability and significantly reduce the risk of fraud. You can simplify the audit process with comprehensive reporting and protect sensitive information with powerful database encryption.

Executive View Licenses

Empower your team, without the extra cost

Give your key stakeholders and department heads the access they need without the expense of a full software license. Users collaborate on budget preparation and access the reports they need. This frees your accounting staff from the time-consuming task of running and distributing reports, allowing them to focus on what matters most.

Fully Auditable General Ledger and Transaction Reports

Achieve total transparency and control

Our fully auditable General Ledger & Transaction Reports make it easy to see all modifications, including the user, date, and time of every entry. Easily filter for specific transaction information and further break down reports by segments, descriptions, debits, credits, and more, ensuring you always have the complete picture you need for full transparency  and compliance.

Helping organizations build better

0+

Mission-driven organizations rely on MIP’s accounting software

0%

Faster task performance and completion of core accounting tasks

FAQs

Have questions about MIP Fund Accounting? We’ve got answers. Learn how MIP simplifies your financial management, integrates with your systems, and supports your organization’s mission.

Still have questions?

Speak with an Expert

request a demo

Account more. Report more. Thrive more.

Momentive’s MIP Accounting handles intricate financial processes and supports finance operations to boost efficiency, improve visibility, and bolster operations. Bring on Better for your organization’s finances.

Explore more accounting solutions

View All

item.title: Workflows, Automation, and Team Efficiency
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Finance Automation Software

Bring on Better Finance Automation Software

Take back your time and embrace financial automation. Improve your approval, data imports/exports, and consolidation processes and boost team efficiency.

Get started

Benefits

More time for what matters

MIP Accounting’s automation software improves team efficiency and coordination getting valuable hours back in the day.

Features

A time machine built-into your computer

Increase team efficiency, while maintaining complete visibility into your finances with MIP Accounting.

Data Import/Export

Eliminate manual data entry and save time

Cut down on manual data entry and human error. Seamlessly transfer information throughout MIP, eliminating time-consuming duplicate entry and significantly reducing the risk of human error, ensuring your financial data is always accurate and up-to-date.

Data Consolidation

Manage and unify your multi-entity organization

If your organization has multiple offices or subsidiaries, this makes it easy to oversee them all while maintaining separate accounting systems. The primary entity can create powerful consolidated reports, adjust balances, and perform allocations, while subsidiary sites can maintain their own segment structures and still report directly to the primary entity. This gives you a comprehensive, unified view of your entire organization's financial health.

Microix Workflow Solutions

Go paperless and streamline your entire workflow

Ready to create a truly paperless office? Microix Workflow Solutions streamlines your entire operational process, from requisitions and purchasing to inventory, budgeting, and timesheets. Build a complete end-to-end purchasing workflow that includes vendor punchouts and enable employees to punch in via various time clocks to make payroll seamless. Microix helps you flow information effortlessly, all while maintaining the security and audit capabilities MIP Accounting is known for.

Automated Bank Feed

Reconcile your accounts in a flash

Eliminate manual entry and tedious comparisons. Automatically match transactions from your bank, saving you hours of work and reducing the risk of human error. You'll have a clear, up-to-the-minute view of your cash balances, all with minimal effort.

Momentive Automated Payments

Take the hassle out of vendor payments

Say goodbye to manual, time-consuming payment processes with Momentive Automated Payments with Corpay as the payment provider. It seamlessly integrates with your general ledger, giving you a clear, centralized view of all your financial data. You'll spend less time on tedious tasks and more time building strong relationships with your vendors.

Helping organizations build better

Mission-driven organizations rely on MIP’s accounting software

0%

Faster task performance and completion of core accounting tasks

request a demo

Account more. Report more. Thrive more.

Momentive’s MIP Accounting handles intricate financial processes and supports finance operations to boost efficiency, improve visibility, and bolster operations. Bring on Better for your organization’s finances.

item.title: Payroll and People Management
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
HR Management Software

Bring on Better HR Management Software

Empower your #1 resource: your people with MIP People.

Get started

Employee Benefits

Make your organization a people person

Effortlessly process payroll with rules unique to your organization and rely on automation process checklists to handle payroll and benefits for your team.

Features

Efficient. Compliant. Employee-centered. MIP People.

Reduce manual workloads, prevent fraud, expediently calculate benefit deductions, clarify reports, all in one easy-to-use system.

Payroll with Direct Deposit capabilities

Pay your team accurately and on time

Ensure your employees are paid on time and with total accuracy. Generate fully allocated accounting entries, maintains comprehensive employee records, and helps you stay completely tax compliant with both paper and e-filing options. Plus, offer your employees the convenience of direct deposit, including the option to split their pay into multiple accounts, all automatically with each paycheck.

Human Resource Management

Simplify HR management and reporting

Take the complexity out of managing employee data. Streamline your payroll process and make updates and changes to employee information directly. The seamless integration with MIP gives you quick and easy access to HR reporting for crucial forms like ACA, FMLA, and EEO, while efficiently tracking key employee data such as certifications, education, and benefit plan adjustments.

Employee Web Services

Give employees 24/7 access to their HR info

Empower your employees and managers with convenient, round-the-clock access to essential information. Employees can easily enter timesheets and view their pay stubs, benefit information, and important messages from anywhere. This self-service functionality frees up your HR team from handling routine information requests, allowing them to focus on more strategic tasks.

Benefit Enrollment

Make benefit enrollment easy for everyone

Simplify the benefit enrollment process for both your employees and your HR team. Give employees direct access to review their current benefits and easily make future elections through a self-guided process on the EWS portal. This streamlines a traditionally complex process, ensuring accurate selections and a better experience for your staff.

item.title: Accounting Software Implementation
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Accounting Software Implementation

Bring on Better Accounting Software Implementation and Consulting

Getting started should feel simple, not overwhelming. Your dedicated implementation team guides you through every step, from data migration and system configuration, right through to acceptance testing and training, so you can hit the ground running.

Connect with our implementation experts

Benefits

Simplify the implementation process

From planning, to go-live, to post-launch, your organization is supported throughout the process. With our people-first approach, you’re never left navigating the process alone; we’re with you every step of the way.

Implementation & Onboarding

Starting our journey together

The MIP Client Services Team has over 60 years of experience with MIP and over 200 years combined experience in accounting. From day one, our project team partners with you to design a tailored implementation plan that reflects your goals, processes, and team structure. We believe in hands-on support—guiding you from kickoff to go-live with clear checkpoints and dedicated resources.

Customer Success and Support

Our relationship doesn’t end at go-live; it only grows stronger.

With a dedicated Customer Success Manager, proactive check-ins, and responsive support by phone, chat, and email, we’re here to ensure your team thrives. You’ll also gain access to our online community, a space to connect with like-minded organizations, share best practices, and learn from real-world experiences. Together, we support your mission.

Support that gets your organization

item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Certification Management Software

Streamline certification.
Elevate certificant value.

Momentive Certification Management Software empowers associations and credentialing bodies to deliver scalable, compliant, and engaging certification programs—simplifying the full lifecycle, from application to renewal.

Speak with an expert

Trusted by credentialing bodies internationally

Join hundreds of organizations managing professional certification programs with Momentive.

What is Certification Management Software?

Certification Management Software is a purpose-built platform that helps organizations manage the full lifecycle of professional credentials. From eligibility and application to renewal and compliance, it centralizes operations and enhances the  certificant experience.

What You Get

Deliver more value with less complexity.

Momentive Certification Management Software helps you reduce operational friction, improve compliance, and deliver a seamless experience for certificants.

Capabilities

Built for certification success

Momentive Certification Management Software offers robust capabilities to support every stage of the certification journey.

A true partner for your organization

From implementation to ongoing support and training, Momentive is with you every step of the way.

Implementation Services

Our dedicated onboarding team brings decades of experience to guide your launch and ensure success. 

Support Services

Access certification-specific expertise and responsive help from our support team whenever you need it.

Training and Development

Grow with in-person, online, and instructor-led training designed to help your team master the platform.

item.title: AI and Automation
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Certification AI Software

Certification AI software to help you focus on what matters most

Momentive Certification Management uses built-in automation and Microsoft Copilot to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and deliver intelligent support.

Get started

Benefits

AI-powered efficiency. Automation that works.

From application routing to CEU tracking and renewal reminders, Momentive helps you automate the certification lifecycle—while giving staff and members intelligent tools to move faster and smarter.

Capabilities

AI and automation tools that scale with you

Designed to help certification teams do more with less—without sacrificing accuracy or control.

Microsoft Copilot

Use natural language to generate summaries, draft communications, and complete tasks.

Portal Copilot (AI chatbot)

Certificants can ask questions and get instant answers from their organization’s AI chatbot including answers about their certification program, certification handbook, and more.

Power Automate integration

Build custom workflows using Microsoft Power Automate to connect certification data with other systems and processes.

Automated eligibility and renewal checks

Verify eligibility, track CEUs, and trigger renewal workflows based on lifecycle rules.

Smart notifications and escalations

Send alerts to staff or certificants when deadlines are approaching, documents are missing, or action is required.

Low-code workflow builder

Configure complex logic and approval paths using point-and-click tools—no developer required.

item.title: Application and Eligibility Management
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Certification Application Management Software

Streamline certification from start to finish

Empower certificants and reduce staff workload with configurable application paths, dynamic rules, and automated workflows.  

Get started

Benefits

Frictionless applications. Configurable eligibility.

Application and eligibility management capabilities are designed to reduce administrative burden, improve applicant satisfaction, and ensure compliance from day one.

Helping organizations build better

0+

Mission-driven organizations rely on MIP’s accounting software

0%

Faster task performance and completion of core accounting tasks

Capabilities

Built to handle the most complex certification programs

Application and eligibility management tools are purpose-built for credentialing bodies and associations with high standards and unique workflows.

Custom application types

Create multiple application types per certification to support different candidate journeys, including supporting payment workflows.

Eligibility verification engine

Based on prerequisites like degrees, CEUs, or prior certifications, candidates can enter pathways and continue the application process independently.

Pre-application qualifier forms

Route candidates to the right certification path before they even begin the application.

Audit-ready documentation

Collect, store, and track supporting documents with secure, scalable storage. Can also leverage honor-based approvals with a defined percentage of applications audited or query-based audits.

Exam integration options

Automatically send and receive demographic and exam eligibility information including special accommodations to testing vendors, scheduling details, and exam results.

Grace period and cycle logic

Configure expiration, renewal, and grace periods with precision—supporting both first-time and returning applicants.

Discover how Momentive Certification Management can streamline your application process, reduce staff workload, and improve the candidate experience.
