item.title: Renewal Management
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Certification Renewal Management

Simplify certificate renewals. Strengthen retention.

Renewal management tools automate the recertification process, reduce certification maintenance compliance risk, and keep certificants engaged—without overwhelming your staff. 

Get started

Benefits

Automated renewals. Confident compliance.

Certification Renewal Management with Momentive helps you maintain high renewal rates, ensure ongoing eligibility, and streamline the entire recertification lifecycle.

Capabilities

Purpose-built for recertification at scale

Renewal management capabilities are designed to support complex, high-volume certification programs with ease.

Automated renewal notifications

Send personalized reminders based on expiration dates, CEU progress, or inactivity.

Grace period and reinstatement logic

Configure flexible grace periods and reinstatement workflows to support lapsed certificants.

Self-reported CEU submission

Allow certificants to log CEUs directly in the portal. 

Segmented renewal paths 

Tailor renewal requirements based on certification type, member role, certificant role, or an individual’s current maintenance progress.

CEU source integration 

Integrate your CE data with your LMS, event platforms, and approved providers to reduce manual entry.

Insightful reports

Generate reports and dashboards that provide you with the info you need to keep your program organized, compliant, and on course to meet your goals.

Helping organizations build better

Certification Management Integrations

Connected certification. Powerful systems.

Seamless certification management integrations help you leverage the tools you already use, ensuring your certification program runs smoothly, your data stays in sync, and your team stays focused.

Get started

Benefits

Certification management integrations for one unified experience.

Momentive connects your certification workflows with the systems that matter most—testing platforms, learning systems, AMS, and more.

Helping organizations build better

0+

Mission-driven organizations rely on MIP’s accounting software

0%

Faster task performance and completion of core accounting tasks

Capabilities

Built to work with your ecosystem

Momentive’s integration strategy is designed to reduce friction, eliminate silos, and support your full tech stack.

Exam provider integrations

Automate exam eligibility, scheduling, and score imports with Pearson VUE, Prometric, and others.

Digital badging

Automatically issue and update badges via Credly or BadgeCert when certification requirements are met or certification renewed.

AMS sync

Provide a 360-degree view of your certificants by integrating with Momentive AMS products and third-party AMS systems.

LMS and event sync

Integrate with Momentive Certification Management Software to pull CEU completions from learning management systems like Path LMS or event platforms like Momentive Event Management Software and support your recertification workflows.

Secure API access 

Automatically send and receive demographic and exam eligibility information including special accommodations to testing vendors, scheduling details, and exam results.

CRM Certification Software

CRM that works with<br> you—and your AMS

Momentive Certification Management includes Microsoft Dynamics 365 to help you manage certification relationships, workflows, and engagement—whether you use it as your primary CRM or connect it to your AMS.

Get started

Benefits

Flexible CRM options. Certification-centric insights.

Whether you rely on your AMS for member management or want a dedicated CRM for certification, Momentive gives you the flexibility to work your way—without sacrificing visibility or control.

Helping organizations build better

0+

Mission-driven organizations rely on MIP’s accounting software

0%

Faster task performance and completion of core accounting tasks

Capabilities

CRM that supports certification—and your tech stack

Designed to support certification-specific workflows while integrating with your broader ecosystem

Microsoft Dynamics 365 

Use the built-in CRM to manage certification contacts, communications, and workflows—no additional license required.

Bi-directional AMS integration

Integrate Momentive Certification Management with your AMS to sync certification status, CEU progress, and engagement data for a unified member view.

360° certificant view

See every certification, renewal, CEU, and interaction in one place, when you integrate Momentive Certification Management with your AMS.

Automated communication triggers 

Send reminders, updates, and marketing messages based on lifecycle stage or engagement level. 

Custom dashboards and Power BI reports 

Visualize engagement trends, renewal forecasts, and certification performance with built-in Power BI dashboards. 

Organization and contact management 

Support complex certification programs by organizing contacts and entities such as certificants, employers, and committees.

item.title: Compliance, Verification, and Reporting
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Certification Compliance Management

Stay compliant. Stay confident .

With powerful certification tools for compliance, reporting, and renewal, you’ll track trends, gain valuable insight, and make informed decisions.

Get started

Benefits

Audit-ready reporting. Real-time certification insights.

Whether you're preparing for certification renewals or optimizing internal operations, Momentive helps you track, verify, and report on every stage of the certification lifecycle.

Capabilities

Compliance and certification reporting tools that work for you

Built to support both external accountability and internal transparency.

Custom report builder

Filter, segment, and export data by certification type, member role, geography, or lifecycle stage.

Role-based dashboards

Provide staff, reviewers, and leadership with the insights they need—without exposing sensitive data.

Audit-ready documentation

Maintain a complete history of applications, approvals, CEUs, and renewals—ready for accreditation reviews or internal audits.

Automated compliance checks

Automatically validate eligibility, CEU completion, and renewal status—reducing risk and manual effort for your staff.

Power BI integration

Access interactive dashboards and visualizations to monitor certification performance, renewal rates, CEU compliance, and more.

Built-in Excel reporting

Use a familiar tool to create charts or pivot tables with your data and make easy-to use templates for the future, all within the same system.

Discover how Momentive helps you meet certification standards, reduce risk, and unlock powerful insights.

Cobalt AMS, built on Microsoft Dynamics 365, helps associations modernize operations, improve accuracy, and enhance the member experience.

Benefits

Why mid-to-enterprise-level associations should choose Cobalt AMS

Cobalt AMS simplifies membership, certification, events, and more—all in one flexible system. Staff work smarter with Microsoft tools, and members enjoy a seamless experience.

features

Member management

Reporting

Nimble AMS

Nimble AMS, built on Salesforce, empowers associations with modern member experiences, smart insights, and future-ready tech through continuous updates, analytics, and automation.

Benefits

Why enterprise-level associations should choose Nimble AMS

Built on Salesforce, Nimble AMS gives associations a powerful, future-ready platform to streamline operations, boost engagement, and make smarter decisions.

Features

Manage members, drive impact, and grow revenue with Nimble AMS

Transform member management with AI-driven insights, automated workflows, and powerful analytics. Your staff can work smarter while members enjoy personalized, seamless interactions—all on the Salesforce platform.

Turn data into decisions

Real time reporting and dashboards give staff visibility into engagement, renewals, and revenue—helping leaders act with confidence.

Automate routine work

Cut down on manual processes by automating renewals, reminders, and communications so staff can focus on member value—all through clicks, no coding required.

Harness the power of AI

Stay ahead of staff and member needs with intelligent, AI-powered solutions. Use Salesforce Einstein to turn member data into smart predictions and personalized recommendations.

Online Community

Transform member engagement with a community embedded directly in your association management software. Support members throughout their journey as they learn, collaborate, and become dedicated advocates.

Stay ahead with continuous upgrades

Choosing Nimble AMS means your technology is future-ready—you’ll always be on the latest product version, with multiple releases per year.

Membership management

Build strong, lasting member relationships with a full 360° perspective and handle intricate membership structures with ease. Empower members to access their events, certifications, affiliations, and account info anytime through their member portal.

item.content:encoded:
Aptify - AMS Page

Aptify AMS

Choose Aptify for enterprise level capabilities, predictable costs, global features, and a platform built to grow with your organization.

Get Started

Benefits

Why large associations and unions should choose Aptify AMS

Aptify is an enterprise AMS designed to give organizations full control over their operations, from membership to events to finances. With 21 built-in applications and a highly configurable platform, Aptify adapts to your workflows and scales to your organization.

Features

Core features that power Aptify AMS

Aptify delivers the tools associations need—from membership to global operations—while integrating modules for a seamless, silo-free experience.

Member management 

Manage your membership with unlimited membership types and dues structures, individual and organizational member management, renewal management, and more.

Local and chapter management

Track an unlimited number of chapters, councils, locals, and other affiliates while also allowing associate individuals to track the history of each membership.

Committee management

Empower internal staff users and external committee members to easily track members, nominees, meetings, assignments, and more.

Reporting

Access hundreds of standard dashboards and reports that your non-technical staff will find easy to run, customize, and manage on their own.

Events and meetings

Manage the lifecycle of any size meeting or trade show – from planning and logistics to marketing, budgeting, and registration. Monitor your success with real-time reporting. 

Order management

Simplify complex transactions by combining memberships, events, merchandise, and subscriptions into a single order. With built-in bundling, pricing, and renewal tools, plus seamless financial integration, you can deliver a unified experience for staff and members.

item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
NetForum - AMS Page

NetForum AMS

NetForum helps mid-sized associations simplify operations, grow revenue, and engage members without heavy IT resources or long implementation timelines. 

Get Started

Benefits

Why mid-sized associations should choose NetForum AMS

NetForum is a proprietary AMS designed to help growing organizations manage every stage of the membership journey. With pre-built functionality, quick implementation, and room to grow, NetForum delivers the tools you need to operate efficiently and scale with confidence.

Optimized Adoption

Get the out-of-the-box features you need to maximize revenue, save staff time, and delight members with the core features of NetForum. As your organization grows and expands member value, you can take advantage of more enterprise-level functionality.

Continued Adoption

Harness all the revenue-driving, robust features built by association industry experts. Larger associations with custom needs an integrations can grow with smarter AMS. Exceed member expectations and deliver a better user experience by providing your team with all the features they need.

features

Simplify operations and elevate member engagement

Build loyalty, save time, and generate more revenue with powerful features designed to simplify operations and delight members. 

Member management 

Manage and streamline the member journey from application to renewal. NetForum’s membership processes will help you save time so you can provide a better member experience. 

CRM

Why juggle two systems? Choose an AMS that includes a powerful CRM at no extra cost. NetForum’s CRM was designed specifically for associations and will help you manage your members efficiently. 

Event management

Events are one of the top revenue generators for associations, and NetForum includes functionality that saves you time on event setup and management to help events run smoothly and return a higher ROI. 

Donor and fundraising management 

Enhance donor engagement and drive fundraising success right from your AMS. Strengthen donor relationships and generate more funds with helpful fundraising features.

Accounting

Choose NetForum AMS with its accounting module to seamlessly integrate your financial data and easily assess your association’s financial health.

Dashboards and advanced reporting

With 300+ customizable reports and intuitive SQL tools, NetForum gives you full control of your data—plus dashboards make membership insights easy to visualize across your organization. 

Member portal with <br>e-commerce

Your members can log in to update their membership, register for events, and purchase subscriptions or merchandise all from a secure, mobile-responsive site. Create a seamless transaction process for your members with NetForum’s modern eWeb solution.

Marketing and communications

Leverage email marketing tools to drive engagement, build membership, and streamline staff processes.

Advertising and subscriptions

Take opportunities for non-dues revenue up a notch with NetForum’s advertising and subscription management features.  

request a demo

Accelerate your membership success  with NetForum

Your mid-sized association needs an AMS that evolves as you grow. Learn more about NetForum AMS.

Explore more association management solutions

item.title: Automation and AI
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
AI for Associations

Let AI and automation do the heavy lifting for your association

Modern associations need technology that anticipates needs, reduces manual work, and surfaces opportunities. With an AI-powered AMS you can automate workflows, provide predictive insights, and help staff deliver more member value efficiently.

Get started

Benefits

Why automation and AI matter for associations 

Automation and AI transform how associations operate. Staff gain tools to streamline tasks and make data-driven decisions. Members enjoy timely, personalized experiences. Boards benefit from clear insights and smarter forecasts — all driving efficiency and strategic growth. 

features

AI-driven tools to elevate your association

A modern AMS blends automation and AI to streamline operations and drive growth. From workflows to chatbots and content assistants, these tools help associations work smarter and serve members better.

Streamline tasks and save time

Automate renewals, event confirmations, and follow-ups. Set it once — the system handles the rest. This reduces errors, saves time, and ensures consistent member communication. 

Automation to enhance the staff experience

Automate staff notifications for new memberships, new event registrations, store purchases, paid invoices, and more to make work easier for your staff.

Smarter support with instant answers

Chatbots embedded in your portal provide instant, accurate answers using your knowledge base. This reduces staff workload and improves member satisfaction.

Personalization that drives engagement 

AI recommends content based on member behavior. Timely, relevant suggestions boost engagement and loyalty. 

FEATURES OVERVIEW

Get more from your association management system

Automated workflows 

AI chat assistant

AI-assisted content creation

Personalized recommendations

Request a Demo

Transform your workflows with automation and AI for associations

See how intelligent automation and AI-powered tools save time, reduce manual tasks, and drive smarter decisions—book your personalized demo today. 

Explore more association management solutions

item.title: Event Management
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Association Event Management

Empower your association with event management tools

Seamlessly create and manage events that elevate engagement and revenue right within your AMS.

Get Started

Benefits

Easy and manageable association meetings and events, with an engaging experience

With association event management capabilities built directly into your AMS, you can plan and deliver seamless events that engage members and create lasting value. From small meetings to large annual conferences, you’ll centralize details, simplify staff workflows, and provide an exceptional experience for every attendee.

Features Overview

Association event management software tools

Personalized registration

Personalized registration flows depending on registration or attendee type. 

Automated emails

Send email confirmation, receipt, reminders.

Tracks & categories

Create tracks and categories for sessions 

Events Calendar

Easily generate an online event calendar with event details. 

Continuing education

Configure number of continuing education for event/session/course. 

Certificates & CE credits

Tie events and sessions to credits and mark them complete after attending.  

Event waitlist

Receive email communication when a spot opens up.

Clone & Replicate

Easily clone events, meetings, sessions, and courses – saving time in event set up.  

Pricing Structures

Support pricing structures for different membership types, member/non-member, and to support group registrant registration rates/discounts.

Request a Demo

AMS for easy to manage, engaging, and
revenue-driven events.

Our AMS solutions take the complexity out of event setup and management, freeing your team to focus on creating revenue-generating experiences with stronger ROI.

Explore more AMS features

View All

item.title: Reporting and Analytics
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Association Reporting and Analytics

Make data work for your association

Real-time association reporting and analytics empower your staff to make smarter, faster decisions. Provide a true big-picture view of your organization to align with your board and refine member engagement.

Get started

Benefits

Move from guesswork to growth with association reporting and analytics.

Ready to enable data-driven decision-making at your association? Choose the right tools to enhance member engagement, streamline administrative tasks, and offer alignment.

features

Tools designed to help associations work smarter

From configurable dashboards to ready-to-use reports, association reporting and analytics features simplify data analysis, enhance visibility, and empower organizations to make confident, informed decisions—without any technical hassle.

Visibility for better decisions

Leverage customizable dashboards to visualize key performance indicators for your organization’s membership, finance, and engagement goals. Whether tracking membership renewals, event registrations or revenue trends, information updates automatically so decisions are based on the latest data.

Flexible reporting at <br>your fingertips

Modern reporting tools are designed for everyone, not just technical staff, reducing reliance on IT and encouraging a culture of data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Data that anticipates your members’ next moves

Analytics go beyond historical reporting to highlight future risks and opportunities. AI can flag members likely to lapse forecast renewal rates or suggest new areas for growth, helping associations take proactive steps rather than reacting after issues arise.

Reports and queries that work for your association

With pre-built association reports and queries, you can generate detailed member, event, or financial reports on demand. Also, schedule recurring reports to be automatically emailed to key stakeholders. Whether running a quick data query or reviewing monthly performance summaries, associations can stay informed and aligned with minimal effort.

FEATURES OVERVIEW

Get more from your association management system

  • Pre-built reports
  • Filterable data visualizations
  • Configurable dashboards
  • Real-time data
  • Role-based access
  • Data segmentation
  • AI-driven data

Request a Demo

Unlock powerful insights with association reporting and analytics

See how our advanced analytics and real-time reporting turn complex data into clear, actionable decisions—schedule your personalized demo today.

Explore more association management solutions

item.title: Member Management
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Member Management Software

One solution. Every member touchpoint.

From recruitment to renewals, Momentive member management software helps you oversee every stage of the membership journey with flexible tools that put your members first.

Get Started

Benefits

Why choose our association member management software?

Momentive association member management software is designed to simplify operations, enhance engagement, and deliver personalized experiences—so your team can focus on what matters most.

Features

Modern member management features for associations

Our association member management software offers robust tools to streamline staff operations and elevate the member experience.

Self-service that actually serves

Let members manage their own profiles, payments, and registrations—anytime, anywhere. Portals also encourage members to engage more frequently with your association, improving satisfaction while reducing staff effort.

One source of truth for every member

Keep all your member data organized, accurate, and accessible in one secure place. With one central hub, collaboration across teams becomes more efficient and staff can easily segment members for campaigns, reports, or outreach.

Less admin. More impact.

Automate renewals, payments, and reminders so your team can focus on growth. Automated billing and renewal tools streamline one of the most critical processes for associations. Staff spend less time chasing renewals, while members enjoy a frictionless experience, boosting retention and reducing administrative load.

Flexible membership models and join processes

Support every type of member with configurable membership tiers, applications, and approval workflows. Whether you offer individual, corporate, or chapter-based memberships, our platform adapts to your structure—making it easy for prospects to join and for staff to manage each step of the process.

Chapter and component management made simple

Empower your chapters or regional groups with tools to manage local memberships, events, and communications while maintaining centralized oversight. Chapter management functionality ensures consistency across your entire organization and empowers local leaders to have autonomy where it matters.

Built-in data security and compliance

Safeguard member data with enterprise-grade security features designed to secure both your organization and your members. With multi-factor authentication (MFA) and compliance support like GDPR, you can trust your member information is protected.

Features Overview

Get more from your association member management software

  • Simplified member onboarding
  • Integrated email and SMS tools
  • Member segmentation and targeting
  • Event registration and tracking
  • Automated renewals and reminders
  • Secure payment processing
  • Custom reporting and analytics

Request a Demo

Take your member management software to the next level

Engage members and drive growth with Momentive’s association management software. Our experts are here to help you find the perfect fit for your organization’s needs.

Explore more AMS features

View All

item.title: Member Portal and E-Commerce
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Membership Portal Software

Empower Members. Unlock Revenue. Simplify Engagement.

Give your association members one easy place to manage their journey—from updating profiles and renewing dues to accessing exclusive content, provide your members a seamless, professional experience while increasing engagement and revenue.

Get started

Benefits

Membership portal software helps you drive engagement and non-dues revenue

Every click inside the portal is an opportunity to strengthen member relationships and generate income. From upselling learning programs to offering premium content, the member portal helps you grow beyond dues revenue.

features overview

Everything members need—all in one place, anytime, anywhere

Membership portal software serves as both a personal dashboard and a one-stop shop, making it easy for members to engage with your organization while helping staff save time.

Self-serve member profiles

Give members the ability to view and update their own contact details, preferences, and account information in real time—reducing manual updates for staff and ensuring your database stays accurate.

Custom dashboards to <br>drive engagement

Customize dashboards to highlight what matters most, including upcoming events, renewal status, community activity and more.

Effortless renewals with recurring payments

Automate dues and subscriptions to boost retention and revenue, helping secure reliable revenue while improving the member experience. With installment payments, make membership dues more manageable through budget-friendly installments.

Smart online store, built-in

Sell products with dynamic pricing, promo codes, and automatic tax and shipping calculations. Offer merchandise, publications, or digital products through an integrated e-commerce store and pricing structures for different membership types.

Instant donations

Make giving easy for members and donors with secure and simple, real-time donation forms.

Mobile-ready member experience

Let members engage, renew, and shop from any device—no friction, no fuss.

Request a Demo

Give members the experience they expect and results your staff will love.

Membership portal software to create opportunities, strengthen engagement, and expand revenue well beyond dues.

Explore more association management solutions

item.title: Member Engagement
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Member Engagement Software

Engage members with clear, consistent communication

Strong communication is the foundation of an engaged and connected membership community. With member engagement software, associations can manage outreach efficiently and offer personalized membership experiences.

Get started

Benefits

Why strong membership communication matters

Clear, consistent communication builds trust and drives engagement. An AMS with integrated tools delivers timely, personalized messages, saving staff time through automation while making members feel valued. Strong communication keeps your community informed, connected, and loyal.

features

Tools to power every message

From email campaigns to automation and segmentation, AMS tools streamline outreach and feed insights back into member records. Staff get intuitive tools; members get thoughtful, consistent communication. In addition, surveys help organizations reach members directly, gathering feedback that drives engagement and informs better decisions.

Run powerful  email campaigns

Design, send, and track emails with built-in tools tied to member records. Templates and dashboards make it easy to deliver effective, professional outreach with drag and drop features. 

Reach the right people at the right time

Segment members by tenure, interests, or engagement. Dynamic lists keep outreach relevant and responsive, driving better results. Deliver tailored, members-only experiences that deepen engagement and reward loyalty.

Create a thriving online community

Offer members a private space to connect and collaborate. Embedded communities deepen engagement and extend the value of membership. These communities foster meaningful relationships that driven loyalty and long-term participation. 

Reach members instantly with text messaging

Send urgent updates via SMS for high visibility. Messages are tracked alongside all other interactions for a complete engagement view. Keep your members informed in real time with instant alerts.

Gather actionable insights from your members

Launch surveys that capture member feedback on programs, events, and services. Tailor questions by segment to ensure relevance, track responses in real time, and analyze trends effortlessly. Turn insights into informed decisions that strengthen engagement and guide association growth.

FEATURES OVERVIEW

Get more from your member engagement software

  • Email marketing
  • Communications reporting
  • Automated messages
  • Audience segmentation
  • Centralized communications
  • Online communities
  • Pre-built templates
  • SMS text messaging
  • Surveys

Request a Demo

Streamline member communications with AMS

Discover how our powerful communication tools simplify outreach, personalize messaging, and boost engagement—schedule your demo today.

item.title: Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
AMS CRM Software

Unify every relationship with membership CRM software

At the heart of any AMS is a powerful CRM to keep your association connected. Centralize your data, members, prospects, donors, partners, and staff to gain a 360° view of every interaction.

Get started

Benefits

Why membership CRM software matters for associations

A built-in CRM gives your association more than just a database, it delivers the insights and connections that drive member satisfaction and organizational growth. By consolidating every interaction into a single source of truth, your staff can work smarter, avoid duplication, and build stronger relationships with members.

Momentive AMS platforms are built on proven CRM frameworks like Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics, or robust native databases, ensuring your team has the data needed to engage effectively and grow every relationship.

features

What your association can do with your CRM in your AMS

Membership CRM software functionality within your AMS equips staff with the tools they need to manage relationships holistically and at scale. The CRM ensures your data is always accessible, useful, and connected. Empower staff to act on insights, personalize member outreach, and coordinate across departments.

See every angle of your members

Each member record provides a comprehensive, 360° view that ties together contact details, financial history, communications, event attendance, certifications, and volunteer activities. Staff can instantly access the full journey of a member, reducing the need to piece together data from multiple systems, and supporting smarter conversations, whether it’s a renewal call or an event invitation.

Target the right audience every time

Built-in filtering and grouping tools allow staff to slice and dice data without needing technical expertise. Create segments for lapsed members, engaged donors, or prospects with specific job titles in seconds. Campaigns and communications become more precise and effective, leading to higher ROI. Dynamic segmentation transforms raw data into actionable groups that drive both engagement and growth.

Seamlessly connect with your applications

Your CRM doesn’t operate in isolation—it connects seamlessly with the tools your staff already use, like Outlook, Teams, email platforms, and accounting systems, reducing the need for duplicate data entry and keeping workflows smooth. Integrations save time, reduce errors, and create a unified ecosystem to empower your entire organization.

FEATURES OVERVIEW

Get more from your membership CRM software

  • Contact management
  • Sales Automation
  • Lead and pipeline tracking
  • Reporting and analytics
  • Communication tools

Request a Demo

Elevate member relationships with CRM software

Experience how our integrated CRM streamlines engagement, tracks interactions, and strengthens connections—book your personalized demo today.

Explore more association management solutions

With our AMS solutions, your association’s accounting and finance processes are simplified, accurate, and connected to everything else you do.<br> Give your staff more time, your board better insights, and your members a smoother experience.

item.title: VMS - Database & Registration
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Volunteer Registration Software

Bring on a Better Volunteer Database and Registration

Volunteers and staff can manage registrations, interests, availability, and feedback from anywhere, making it easier to engage with volunteers than ever before.

Get started

Benefits

Save time and focus on volunteer engagement

Empower volunteers to manage their own information, sign up for opportunities, and track their impact—all from one easy-to-use platform.

Features

Engage volunteers, protect their data, and promote your mission with our secure volunteer management database

Easily match volunteers to the right roles with a centralized, customizable database. With VolunteerMatters, you’ll create a secure, on-brand experience that strengthens connections between your volunteers and your mission, fueling better outcomes.

BETTER VOLUNTEER ENGAGEMENT

Match volunteers with the right roles

Use VolunteerMatters' centralized database to track skills, interests, and preferences, as well as up-to-date contact information. The volunteer-managed data helps your team effortlessly match volunteers with opportunities that align with their passions, enhancing their commitment and satisfaction.

CUSTOM VOLUNTEER DATABASE

Streamline volunteer tracking for better results

Customize your volunteer database to match your organization’s unique requirements. Define and customize data fields, choosing types, appearance, and configurations for centralized management of all volunteer information. Volunteers can self-manage their personal profile, making engagement easier.

SOC 2 COMPLIANCE

Feel confident your volunteer data is secure and private

item.title: VMS - Shift Sign-Up and Scheduling
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Volunteer Scheduling Software

Bring on a Better Volunteer Scheduling and Sign-Up

No more paper or outdated tools to create and manage volunteer schedules and sign-ups. With a comprehensive set of tools and personalized dashboards, you can set schedules or let volunteers manage their time and commitments with ease. 

Get started with VolunteerMatters

Benefits

Scale volunteer management across programs, sites, and events

Whether you’re a small nonprofit or a large association, our dedicated support, intuitive tools, and ongoing updates, help your team and volunteers save time and stay focused on your mission.

Features

Save time by organizing volunteers shifts and sign-ups efficiently

Better recruit volunteers using a suite of tools made for purpose-driven organizations, including smart scheduling software, custom online volunteer sign-up forms, landing pages, and automated communication tools. 

VOLUNTEER RECRUITMENT LANDING PAGES

Increase volunteer sign-ups with custom landing pages

Build unlimited, branded pages and forms to promote roles, events, or projects—everything you need to attract the right people, all in one place. Your team can create a landing page for a one-time event or develop a full online volunteer sign-up form for a long-term project; all the tools you need are at your disposal. 

E-MAIL AND TEXT COMMUNICATION 

Easy communication tools to engage and inform

Create customized volunteer sign-up forms for your nonprofit's volunteer program, then integrate simple no-code automated communication tools to keep registrants in the loop. This includes everything from welcome e-mails to automated text messages. 

VOLUNTEER SCHEDuLING SOFTWARE

Schedule dates and time slots easily

Effortlessly coordinate event dates and volunteer shifts with VolunteerMatters’ easy-to-use volunteer scheduling software. Plan and organize volunteer availability and check for empty time slots in real-time for any project or initiative. 

VOLUNTEER-SET SCHEDULES

Take Control of Volunteer Scheduling and Assignments

Let volunteers set their own schedules or give your administrators the tools they need to assign schedules as they see fit. With VolunteerMatters, it’s easy to create, track, and manage schedules and assignments.

item.title: Volunteer Hour Tracking and Reporting
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Volunteer Tracking Software

Bring on Better Volunteer Tracking and Reporting

Keep track of volunteer hours, run reports, and help teams manage their time with VolunteerMatters’ efficient, easy-to-use volunteer time-tracking tool.

Get started with VolunteerMatters

Benefits

Why Volunteer Management?

Whether you’re a small nonprofit or a large association, our dedicated support, intuitive tools, and ongoing updates, help your team and volunteers save time and stay focused on your mission.

Features

Automate, simplify, and streamline volunteer hours tracking

Tracking volunteer hours is a must for every organization working with volunteers. Keep it simple, scalable, and efficient with a host of features that make time tracking easy for volunteers and your nonprofit.

SELF-CHECK-IN SYSTEM

Smarter volunteer tracking, less manual work 

Build unlimited, branded pages and forms to promote roles, events, or projects—everything you need to attract the right people, all in one place. Your team can create a landing page for a one-time event or develop a full online volunteer sign-up form for a long-term project; all the tools you need are at your disposal. 

MOBILE AND KIOSK CHECK-IN

Make volunteer attendance easy and accurate

Let volunteers check in and out via a kiosk or their own mobile devices. Self-check-in and out saves time, reduces errors, and empowers volunteers to track their hours on the go. 

TIMESHEET SUBMISSIONS

Track volunteer contributions clearly and easily

Let volunteers in certain positions self-report hours in a clear, easy to understand timesheet format, building a strong sense of trust, transparency, and accountability when tracking volunteer time.

AUTO-CREDIT HOURS

Streamline hour management and reduce admin work

Allocate a predetermined number of hours a volunteer will be credited based on their position, assignments, or upon task completions. This simple automation in VolunteerMatters can save your team hours of admin work. 

LOCATION-BASED VERIFICATION

Keep volunteer tracking precise and reliable

Verify volunteers’ locations to ensure they’re physically present before allowing check-ins. It’s a great way to ensure hours are accurate, project tasks are complete, and volunteers stay efficient.

Built-in data security and compliance

Safeguard member data with enterprise-grade security features designed to secure both your organization and your members. With multi-factor authentication (MFA) and compliance support like GDPR, you can trust your member information is protected.

item.title: VMS - Onboarding, Background Checks, Compliance
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Volunteer Onboarding Software

Bring on Better Volunteer Onboarding, Background Checks, and Compliance

Powerful volunteer onboarding software streamlines the process from initial application to active participation with comprehensive vetting, training, background checks, and document verification. Manage and automate all stages of volunteer onboarding with ease.

Get started with VolunteerMatters

Benefits

Why Volunteer Management?

Features

Streamline volunteer onboarding with software that does more

Automate the volunteer onboarding process. Required questions help determine volunteer suitability right from the start. Ensure volunteers are appropriately screened and ready with background checks and training, all managed from a single platform without anything falling through the cracks.

SEAMLESS VOLUNTEER BACKGROUND CHECKS

Simplify screening and easily maintain compliance and safety

VolunteerMatters integrates with top background check providers to automate the process. Volunteers submit forms from any device, and your team gets real-time updates and easy-to-read dashboards—making vetting fast, simple, and stress-free.

SELF-SERVICE ONBOARDING

Empower volunteers on their schedule

Volunteers can complete onboarding requirements on their schedule, and administrators can quickly and easily approve only the applicants who complete onboarding as required.

CUSTOMIZE VOLUNTEER APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

Tailor volunteer opportunities for the perfect fit

Effectively tailor application forms to specific volunteer positions and scale opportunities across multiple locations. Being able to ask the right questions to better gauge applicant suitability ensures the right volunteer matches the right project and role.

TRACK VOLUNTEER PROGRESS

Keep volunteers on track with dashboard insights

Gain greater visibility into volunteer training and induction via your VolunteerMatters dashboard. Your team can set up push notifications to prompt volunteers to complete modules, freeing your team from basic administrative tasks.

EASY TRAINING SETUP AND OPTIONAL LMS INTEGRATION

Train volunteers anywhere, anytime

With VolunteerMatters’ embedded LMS, volunteers can complete courses, watch videos, and access interactive content directly in one familiar portal. Prefer your existing LMS? Integrate it effortlessly with VolunteerMatters and keep training records automatically up to date.

Powering proven results that increase efficiency and impact

item.content:encoded:
Volunteer Recruitment Software

Bring on Better Volunteer Recruitment and Communications

Engage with existing volunteers, find new prospects, and promote your program effectively with our volunteer recruitment software. Simplify communications through automated volunteer sign-ups, automated e-mails, built-in texting, and social media integrations. 

Get started with VolunteerMatters

Benefits

Simplify recruiting and managing volunteers

Automated onboarding and built-in messaging tools make it easy to attract, manage, and retain volunteers. Built-in e-mail, text messaging, and social media keep your community active and growing.

Features

Connecting organizations and volunteers for 20+ years 

Keep volunteers informed and engaged, with easy self-registration, automated onboarding, and timely updates.

SELF-REGISTRATION SYSTEM

Save time with our volunteer recruitment scheduling

Your volunteers can proactively search for and sign up for opportunities through the VolunteerMatters self-registration system, with their time and date preferences top of mind. Our automated onboarding workflow handles registration and verification, creating a smooth process that reduces administrative workload.

ADVANCED, AUTOMATED E-MAIL TOOLS

Keep volunteers informed and motivated

Set up e-mails to notify volunteers upon registration, remind them of their commitments to reduce no-shows, and send thank-yous post-assignment. Help your volunteers feel needed and appreciated to foster a more engaging volunteer experience.

PERSONALIZED, AUTOMATED TEXT MESSAGING

Foster community and recognition with direct communication

Send targeted, compliant recruitment text messages to acknowledge past contributions, give updates on current roles, or inform them of future opportunities. Volunteers appreciate the convenience of text messaging.

SOCIAL MEDIA INTEGRATION

Streamline the recruitment and onboarding process

Create a shareable post with your project’s image, name, description, and link to your recruitment page – with just one click. Let volunteers spread the word about your program on social media to encourage maximum participation.

item.content:encoded:
Volunteer Engagement Software

Bring on Better Volunteer Engagement and Project Management

Our comprehensive volunteer management solution is designed to help you amplify your volunteer engagement, making it easy to streamline volunteer management, boost engagement, and maximize the impact of your volunteer programs.

Get started with VolunteerMatters

Benefits

Engage volunteers and drive positive change

By fostering strong relationships and streamlining processes, VolunteerMatters maximizes the impact of your volunteer programs.

Features

Tools to implement volunteer engagement ideas

VolunteerMatters provides a range of features to help you put volunteer engagement ideas into action. Our platform empowers you to implement effective volunteer engagement strategies that keep volunteers motivated and committed.

CUSTOMIZEABLE, CENTRALIZED DATABASE

Make every volunteer feel valued and understood

Track skills, interests, and preferences for thousands of volunteers with our secure volunteer portal. Volunteers can easily self-manage their information, helping your team home  in on the opportunities that keep them coming back to your mission.

REPORTING TOOLS

Volunteers can always access their impact data

Volunteers can easily quantify the number of hours, courses, and assignments with VolunteerMatters reporting, so they always know the real impact they’ve had on your nonprofit’s mission.

FULL CYCLE VOLUNTEER MANAGEMENT

Tools you need for every step of the volunteer journey

Our platform supports every step of volunteer management, from recruitment to feedback. Customize your engagement tactics with automated communications, including confirmations, reminders, thank-you messages, feedback requests, and birthday e-mails. VolunteerMatters also simplifies applications, vetting, training, scheduling, and hours tracking.

FEEDBACK TOOLS

Simplifying engaging volunteers

Survey volunteers post-assignment to understand their experience and identify areas for improvement. By continuously enhancing your volunteer programs based on feedback, you create a more engaging and rewarding environment for your volunteers.

CUSTOM PROJECT LANDING PAGES

Target the right audience

Keep your project details well-organized with unique landing pages that fit your brand. Whether you need to provide sponsorship activation, offer “by invitation only” projects, specific scheduling, or other unique project parameters, VolunteerMatters best supports your volunteer project management.

Powering proven results that increase efficiency and impact

item.content:encoded:
Implementation & Services

Career Center Implementation & Services

Benefit from a dedicated team that handles implementation, optimization, and ongoing growth. We partner with your association every step of the way, helping you turn your career center into a high-performing asset, without overburdening internal staff. 

Get started

Benefits

Better outcomes with white-glove service and strategic support 

By combining deep industry expertise, hands-on management, and a full-service success framework, our implementation team ensures your career center launches strong—and continues to grow.  

Features

Better service—so your association can bring on better impact 

Gain a true partner in execution, not just a software vendor. 

Turnkey Implementation & Launch

Deployments—done right from day one

Our experts guide you through every step of setup, from brand alignment and system configuration to integrations and launch. We take care of the details so you can focus on your membership mission. Your association benefits from custom branding and UI setup, system and data integration between AMS, CRM, and websites, and migration support for legacy job boards and data.  

Best Practices & KPI Monitoring

Top-line performance through active oversight

We don’t just hand over the system—we live in it. Our team actively tracks key metrics, recommends optimizations, and drives campaigns to boost traffic, engagement, and revenue. Benefit from hands-on performance benchmarking, monthly/quarterly business reviews, optimization recommendations for job postings, SEO, content, and alerts and dashboards to track candidate and employer behavior. 

Marketing & Job Board Promotion

Visibility, without the heavy lifting

Leverage our marketing expertise to promote your career center, drive employer adoption, and attract job seeker traffic. Take the heavy lifting out of strategic email campaigns and “Job Flash™” delivery, SEO optimization and job distribution across channels, paid acquisition strategies and ad promotions, and effortless co-branded promotional assets and content.

Recruitment Ad Sales & Monetization Support

Expert sales support backing you

Our niche recruitment ad sales team works alongside your staff (or in full partnership) to generate ad deals, sponsorships, and event monetization. Our team works with your association to deliver lead generation for employer outreach, sales enablement materials and training, revenue forecasting and packaging support, and ongoing account management and upsell strategy. 

Ongoing Support & Innovation

Service and a system that perform

Your success team stays active long after launch—handling support, enhancements, and product updates so your association always stays ahead. Benefit from employer and  job seeker support (customer-facing help); staff training, onboarding, and refresher sessions; roadmap-driven product enhancements; and billing, collections, and administrative support. 

A true partner for your organization

From implementation to ongoing support and training, Momentive is with you every step of the way.

Implementation Services

Gain access to a dedicated team that handles implementation, optimization, and ongoing growth.

Career center software that fits  your organization

Employ a suite of solutions that empower organizations to do more, connect more, and create organizational success. Meet the tools that fit your organization:

item.content:encoded:
Job Board Software

Connecting to grow your mission

Connect mission-driven organizations, employers, and professionals through the largest network of association-backed career sites, where every posting supports a purpose and every placement advances a field.

Get started

Benefits

Empowering associations,
employers, members

For associations, your brand is trusted. For employers, your audience is hard to reach. We bridge that gap and empower associations to deliver career resources that matter while driving engagement, retention, and non-dues revenue.

Features

Take members on the next step of their job journey

Customer-branded Design and Smart Tools

Make your job board uniquely yours

Seamlessly integrate your association’s look and feel for a cohesive member experience. With AI, you can automatically highlight key job details, providing summaries for relevant positions and helping members quickly assess whether a role aligns with their experience and interests.

Personalized Job Matching

Top-line performance through active oversight

Intelligent recommendations pair candidates with the right opportunities based on skills, interests, and career goals. Increase engagement and job views by recommending opportunities to job seekers based on their prior searches.

Advanced Data and Analytics

Influencing the decisions that matter

Empower your staff with essential knowledge of job board sales, performance, and user behavior to drive growth in membership and revenue.

Candidate Screening and Management

Making hiring simple

Streamline hiring workflows with built-in tools that simplify shortlisting and communication. Provide employers with functionality to attract, screen, and manage applicants, including an anonymous resume bank that safeguards job seekers' identities and confidentiality.

A true partner for your organization

From implementation to ongoing support and training, Momentive is with you every step of the way.

item.title: Career Center - Events and Networking
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Career Fairs and Events

Creating engaging events that grow connections

Turn every event into a catalyst for connection, growth, and engagement. Whether onsite, virtual, or hybrid, our platform brings together members, employers, and industry partners, creating experiences that inspire action and strengthen communities.

Get started

Benefits

Bring on better connections and engagement at scale

Deliver high-impact career fairs that connect your members with top employers. Power engaging experiences that support job seeker and recruiter interaction, drive sponsor visibility, and reinforce your association’s role in advancing careers. From virtual booths to real-time chat and resume exchange, our Career Fairs create meaningful connections that fuel professional growth and member retention.

Features

Bring on better events for members

From virtual job fairs to online networking, every event is designed to drive measurable results: deeper member relationships, higher employer visibility, and new non-dues revenue streams.

Job Fairs (Onsite, Virtual, Hybrid)

Events that drive real results

Employers showcase opportunities to targeted audiences, members discover their next step, and associations strengthen their role as the hub for professional growth. Benefit from custom-branded event portals that reflect your association’s identity, real-time chat and video interviews for instant connection, and post-event analytics and lead generation to prove ROI.

Virtual Career Fairs

Engagement at scale

Host immersive virtual career fairs that combine career development, networking, and sponsorship visibility, all within a seamless, branded experience. Easily support speaker sessions, breakout rooms, and employer engagement to make every event dynamic and impactful.

Online Resume Review

Resume readiness for every member

Help members put their best foot forward with live or asynchronous resume review sessions. Partner with coaches or employers to deliver actionable feedback that builds confidenceand keeps members returning to your career center. Benefit from a seamless integration with career center tools and employer participation that drives connection and visibility.

Recruitment Guides

Expert employer resources

Equip employers with actionable insights to attract top talent in niche fields. From crafting standout job descriptions to optimizing postings across association networks, these guides help employers succeed and strengthen your value as their go-to recruitment partner. Develop co-branded member communications to drive audience engagement and share best practices for job posting and candidate outreach.

A true partner for your organization

From implementation to ongoing support and training, Momentive is with you every step of the way.

Implementation Services

Gain access to a dedicated team that handles implementation, optimization, and ongoing growth.

Our Solutions

Career center software that fits  your organization

Employ a suite of solutions that empower organizations to do more, connect more, and create organizational success. Meet the tools that fit your organization:

item.title: Career Center - Career Development Tools
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Career Development Tools

Building career destinations for associations

Your members deserve more than just a job board—they deserve a destination for their careers. Bring on better outcomes by connecting members with the right opportunities, attract employers seeking specialized talent, and generate reliable non-dues revenue, all while strengthening engagement and loyalty.

Get started

Benefits

Bring on better careers and stronger connections.

Turn your career center into a growth engine—for members, employers, and associations. Together, we help people do more than find jobs. We help them build meaningful careers.

Features

Career development tools that meet member needs

Make your career center the go-to hub for career advancement with features like career pathing and planning, insights, advice, and coaching.

Career Paths

Direction for every Career Journey™

Give members a clear roadmap for growth within your industry. With defined milestones, role progression insights, and tailored resources, professionals can see exactly what it takes to advance—and how your association supports them at every step. For associations, it’s a way to position your brand as the trusted guide in every member’s long-term success story.

Career Planning Portal

Planning for lifelong careers

Members can assess their strengths, set goals, and access personalized tools—all within a single, intuitive portal. Empower professionals to take charge of their Career Journey™, while keeping your association at the heart of their career development. It’s continuous engagement, driven by continuous growth.

Career Insights

Data-driven insights

Help members explore every role in your industry with insights into salary, skills, job outlook, education requirements, and even “day in the life” videos. Turn curiosity into clarity, guiding professionals toward confident, informed career choices. For associations, it’s a powerful way to showcase industry intelligence and strengthen your role as the career authority. 

Career Advice & Coaching

Guidance for every step.

From resume writing to interview prep to leadership growth, help professionals succeed at every stage with articles, expert perspectives, and actionable tips. Plus, facilitate connections with certified professionals for one-on-one help in resume building, interviewing, career transitions, and negotiation. It’s a tailored, human touch that builds confidence, develops skills, and deepens your members’ relationship with your organization.

InternBoard

Better opportunities for tomorrow’s leaders

Help students and emerging professionals take their first step with purpose. By connecting them with meaningful internships in their chosen field, your association strengthens the talent pipeline and supports the next generation of industry leaders.  

A true partner for your organization

From implementation to ongoing support and training, Momentive is with you every step of the way.

Implementation Services

Gain access to a dedicated team that handles implementation, optimization, and ongoing growth.

Our Solutions

Career center software that fits  your organization

Employ a suite of solutions that empower organizations to do more, connect more, and create organizational success. Meet the tools that fit your organization:

Career Center – Non-Dues Revenue

Learn more

Career Center – Implementation & Services

Learn more

Career Center – Job Board

Learn more

Career Center – Events and Networking

Learn more

Career Center – Career Development Tools

Learn more

Career Center – Recruitment Marketing

Learn more

Career Center – Job Board Integrations

Learn more

Request a demo

Connect more. Manage more. Expect more.

YM Careers helps associations bring on better outcomes for their members, employers, and mission. With powerful tools for career development, recruitment marketing, and events, YM Careers transforms your organization into the go-to hub for industry advancement, helping you connect more, manage more, and expect more.

Explore more career centers solutions

View All

item.title: Career Center - Recruitment Marketing
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Recruitment Marketing Services

Helping associations create a network of opportunities

Recruitment marketing that creates a comprehensive network of opportunities for members–that maximizes their unique specialized set of skills. Build a thriving career ecosystem that benefits associations, employers, and members with a team of experts that take the load off of your staff.

Get started

Benefits

Bring on better visibility. Bring on better reach.

From targeted marketing to network-wide distribution, our expert sales and marketing team becomes an extension of your staff to help associations deliver exceptional value to employers while driving lasting engagement, relevance, and revenue.

Features

Bring on better visibility for employers.

Employers want more than job postings. Elevate their brand through targeted advertising, newsletters, banners, and event sponsorships to reach engaged, industry-specific audiences. Associations can build stronger relationships with employers while generating sustainable non-dues revenue.

Job Flash™ Email

Keeping members up to date

Deliver new job opportunities directly to members’ inboxes, driving visibility and fast results for employers.

Expert SEO & Job Distribution

Optimize job listings to meet members

Maximize exposure across search engines and job aggregators, ensuring every posting reaches the right professionals.

Advanced Data & Analytics

Informed and detailed results

Job Board Integrations

Create a complete association platform

Integrate seamlessly with your AMS website so your data, members, and workflows stay in sync. 

Get started

Benefits

Better connections between every tool you use

No more disconnected systems or duplicate data entry. Associations can reduce manual work, improve data quality, and deliver cohesive experiences across every touchpoint. 

Features

Building Better Associations

When your systems work together, you can connect more, manage more, and expect more from every tool you use. 

Simplify operations

Reduce duplicate work and administrative overhead.

With the Momentive platform, it’s easy to integrate systems. Unify your data between YM Careers and YourMembership, Nimble AMS, Aptify, and NetForum. Improve data quality and unify the member experience—all while unlocking smarter insights. Together, the Momentive platform allows for richer reporting and analytics to inform decisions and demonstrate impact.

Limitless integrations

One platform. Unlimited success.

With flexible APIs and data connectors, YM Careers can integrate with virtually any technology stack your organization depends on. Unify your data and reap the benefits of a connected platform.  

A true partner for your organization

From implementation to ongoing support and training, Momentive is with you every step of the way.

Implementation Services

Gain access to a dedicated team that handles implementation, optimization, and ongoing growth.

item.content:encoded:
Charity Auction Software

Bring on Better Auctions, from Anywhere

Transform every auction into an unforgettable experience with GiveSmart. Inspire generosity, whether in-person, virtual, or hybrid. Our mobile bidding tools create excitement, increase participation, and streamline payments, helping you raise more with less effort.

Get started with GiveSmart

Benefits

Engage more. Raise more.

GiveSmart’s all-in-one auction solution turns fundraising into an experience your supporters will love. From instant notifications to mobile bidding and simplified checkout, we help you drive excitement, keep guests engaged, reduce friction, and elevate every moment of giving.

Features

Manage more with our auction tools

GiveSmart’s auction and mobile bidding platform combines flexibility, speed, and simplicity, so your team can focus on mission, not minutiae.

Mobile Bidding and Notifications

Keep supporters connected and encourage bidding

Guests can browse items, set max bids, and receive instant outbid alerts—all from their phones.

Live and Virtual Event Support

Host from anywhere, manage from one place

Run hybrid or fully virtual auctions with live-stream integration, presentation tools, and real-time data tracking. Our Services Team can also offer live event support for your auction, amplifying results.

Unified Checkout and Payments

End events with ease

Conclude your auction in minutes with automatic payment processing, receipts, and item fulfillment built directly into the platform.

Real-Time Reporting and Analytics

Measure success instantly

Monitor bidding activity, top donors, and revenue totals live to adjust strategy and maximize in-the-moment results.

Custom Branding and Design

Make every auction uniquely yours

Customize your event site with your organization’s logo, colors, and messaging for a polished, on-brand experience that delights donors.

A true partner for your organization

From implementation to ongoing support and training, Momentive is with you every step of the way.

Implementation Services

Gain access to a dedicated team that handles implementation, optimization, and ongoing growth.

Our Solutions

item.title: Online Giving and Payments
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Online Fundraising

Amplify your online fundraising impact

GiveSmart’s online fundraising tools create friction-free donor experiences — from mobile-friendly forms to recurring giving and digital wallets — so you can stay focused on what matters most: your mission.

Get started with GiveSmart

Benefits

Bring on better online fundraising experiences. Bring on better results.

From one-time donations to recurring gifts, GiveSmart equips nonprofit organizations, schools, and associations with tools that inspire donors to give more frequently and easily. Our fundraising platform reduces barriers, builds loyalty, and allows your team the flexibility to manage every gift from one dashboard.

Features

Tools that make online fundraising simple and secure

GiveSmart’s online fundraising and payments solution is purpose-built for modern fundraising: flexible, secure, and designed to delight donors.

Recurring Giving

Build support that lasts

Turn one-time donors into lifelong advocates with flexible recurring options and automated pop-up suggestions.

Embeddable Donation Forms

Make giving on brand

Embed customizable forms seamlessly on your website or campaign page. Donors never have to leave your website to give, which increases conversions and reduces drop-off.

Digital Wallet and Mobile Payments

Friction-free giving, happier donors

Enable Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, Venmo, and other modern payment methods. One tap is all it takes, giving supporters the freedom to give securely with one tap.

Smart Receipts and Acknowledgments

Thank donors faster and steward them better

Automated thank-you messages and tax receipts ensure donors feel appreciated the moment they give, a critical touchpoint for retaining supporters and fueling your long-term fundraising growth.

Reporting and Insights

Track impact in real time

Access detailed giving analytics, recurring gift trends, and donor performance metrics from a single dashboard. Make smarter decisions to continuously optimize your online fundraising results.

FAQ

Request a Demo

GiveSmart by Momentive Software connects organizations with donors on an engaging, modern, all-in-one fundraising solution. Bring on better for your organization’s mission.

item.title: Ticketing and Guest Management
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Nonprofit Ticketing Software

Bring on Better Ticketing and Guest Management

Offer cohesive experiences that start before the first hello. From ticket purchase to check-in and checkout, GiveSmart streamlines every step of your event. Whether you’re hosting a gala, 5K, or golf tournament, our ticketing and guest management tools deliver a smooth experience for attendees and a simpler, smarter process for your team.

Get started with GiveSmart

Benefits

Simplify event logistics and wow your guests

GiveSmart helps you eliminate the stress of managing guest logistics while elevating your event from start to finish. Simplify ticket sales, reduce lines, and deliver a memorable experience that keeps supporters coming back. 

Features

Better fundraising event organization from start to finish

GiveSmart’s ticketing and guest management features empower your team to deliver a professional, polished experience while gaining insights that improve every future event.

Integrated Ticketing Platform

Smarter ticketing for higher event revenue

Create and manage tickets with dynamic pricing, promo codes, and group options that are all built into your fundraising event page.

Contactless Check-In

Fast, easy, and frustration-free

Allow your guests to skip the line and check in from their mobile phones with a simple link, so they can get on to the fun and giving.

Unified Guest Data

Connected reporting for smarter follow-up

Track attendance, donations, and bidding activity in one central database for post-event reporting, outreach, and stewardship.

Seating Management

Take the stress out of seating and guest details

Assign seats, tables, golf foursomes, and other group guests and have a quick view of custom preferences like meal selection for smooth coordination and an elevated guest experience.

Efficient Checkout

Close out your event with ease

Automate post-event payments, send receipts instantly, and access reports to close out your event faster than ever.

Request a Demo

Connect More. Manage More. Raise More.

GiveSmart by Momentive Software connects organizations with donors on an engaging, modern, all-in-one fundraising solution. Bring on better for your organization’s mission.

Explore more fundraising solutions

View All

item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
GiveSmart Integrations

Bring on Better Fundraising Software Integrations

Unlock your donors’ potential using GiveSmart integrations built for your CRM, event execution, and reporting tools. <br><br> Our integrations help connect your systems and enhance your donor experiences. Save time by accelerating your fundraising efforts.

Connect with our fundraising experts

Benefits

Bring on better alignment. Bring on better efficiency.

When systems communicate, your team saves time and gains visibility. GiveSmart integrations create a unified workflow that helps you strengthen donor relationships, streamline reporting, and make data-driven decisions with confidence.

INTEGRATIONS

Bring on better connections that drive smarter fundraising.

GiveSmart integrations unify your fundraising ecosystem so every tool works together to support your goals- accurately, automatically, and intelligently.

Donor CRM Integrations

Connect where your donors already live.

Sync with industry-leading platforms like GiveSmart Donor CRM, Salesforce, Raiser’s Edge, and DonorPerfect for real-time updates and reliable data flow.

Accounting Integration

Keep finances clean  and compliant.

Directly connect to MIP Accounting® to simplify reconciliation and reporting. <br><br> Eliminate manual data entry and data manipulation, file import/export processes, and multiple reporting workflows and duplicative actions. With GiveSmart and MIP Accounting, your teams can more closely align projections with expected revenue, improving stability and planning.

Automatic Record Updates

Always stay current.

Changes to donor data, event activity, or transactions are updated automatically across systems—no double work required. GiveSmart’s automatic data flow and synced activities break down silos and increase efficiency, giving you more time to steward your donors.

Centralized Reporting

See everything in one place.

Access comprehensive dashboards that consolidate fundraising, donor, and accounting data into a single source of truth with GiveSmart + MIP.

Digital Wallets and Tap to PaY

Secure, easy ways to give.

Digital wallets, such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal, are very secure, incredibly convenient, and donor-centered. Clover Go by Fiserv accepts Tap and Chip payments at in-person events, with increased reliability through Bluetooth connections. Guests can pay with digital wallets or contactless cards and get through check-in and checkout faster.

Matching Gifts

Increase the impact  of donations.

Easily incorporate matching gifts in your fundraising appeals. Mentioning gift matching in fundraising appeals yields a 71% surge in response rate and a 51% boost in average donation amount. <a href="https://doublethedonation.com/givesmart-dtd-partnership-announcement/" target="_blank" style="text-decoration:underline;">GiveSmart proudly integrates with Double the Donation</a>.

Helping organizations raise more

item.title: Custom Forms
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Form Building Software

Every form, perfectly tailored to your mission.

Fundraising goes far beyond donations, and with GiveSmart, your forms can too. Capture sponsorships, basic volunteer sign-ups, merchandise sales, auction item procurement, registrations, and more with customizable forms that fit seamlessly into your campaigns. Bring on better forms that work like you do.

Get started with GiveSmart

Benefits

Bring on better flexibility. Bring on better engagement. 

From simple donation forms to complex event workflows, GiveSmart’s custom forms adapt to your needs. Build beautiful, branded forms that collect the right information, simplify the donor experience, and keep your team organized, without all the headaches.

Features

Bring on better tools that simplify every sign-up and sale.

GiveSmart’s form builder puts power and flexibility in your hands, so you can create, launch, and manage forms that drive results; no coding required. 

Flexible Field Management

Collect the details that matter 

Add, remove, or rearrange fields for sponsorship levels, volunteer interests, shirt sizes, or donation tiers in mere minutes. Capture the information you need in one place and easily access it at your fingertips. Never make a mistake with donor details again. 

Embeddable Form Options

Keep supporters on your site

Embed forms directly into your organization’s website or campaign page, cutting steps for your donors. Consolidating payment processing saves your organization money, makes it easier for donors, and helps you track your funds in one convenient place.  

Integrated Payments

Make every form actionable

Connect payments and digital wallets, such as Apple Pay and Venmo, to your forms for immediate transactions; no redirects, no extra steps. Digital wallets also offer an additional layer of protection. Make it secure and convenient for donors from the ballroom to the living room to give.  

Real-Time Reporting

Know what’s working as it happens

Monitor submissions, payment totals, and engagement from a single dashboard with built-in analytics. You can better understand which forms are driving the most donations, so impactful adjustments can be made. 

Templates and Branding Tools

Build faster, stay consistent

Use customizable templates with your organization’s branding to save time and maintain a cohesive look, feel, and donor experience. Consistency in branding reinforces your overall message and best leverages your mission.

item.content:encoded:
Fundraising Software

Fundraising Management at Your Fingertips

Raise more with our smart, simple fundraising software and the support of a partner invested in your success.

Talk to an expert
Watch the Demo

Helping thousands of nonprofits, associations, and other organizations fund their missions.

Grow your revenue with GiveSmart.

Make your mission a movement with our fundraising software

Gain access to all our fundraising tools, from event ticketing and auctions to peer-to-peer campaigns, text-to-give outreach, and everything in between. Better reach your donors with our tools.

What You Get

Fundraising tools that work together

Simplify your fundraising, drive event success, and host successful campaigns with GiveSmart. Access a wide range of tools and features that inspire donors throughout the year.

Helping organizations raise more

$0B

Raised

$0M

Raised YTD (as of 3/31/2026)

Our Fundraising Solutions

Fundraising software that supports your mission and donors

GiveSmart’s flexible, customizable fundraising tools help you do more. From annual galas to golf outings, peer-to-peer runs, or Giving Tuesday campaigns, we provide the solutions to drive your mission forward.

Online Giving  and Payments

Boost donor loyalty and simplify giving with our forms, payments, and features.

Learn more

Auctions and Mobile Bidding

Power seamless auctions from anywhere with accessible tools.

Learn more

Ticketing and Guest Management

Create stress-free events with seamless check-in, seating, and checkout.

Learn more

Custom Forms

Streamline donations, sales, and  sign-ups with our flexible forms.

Learn more

Peer-to-Peer Fundraising and Crowdfunding

Fuel supporter-led fundraising with easy setup and social tools.

Learn more

Campaign and Event Management

Create mission-aligned campaigns with real-time data and complete flexibility.

Learn more

Raffles, Voting, and Item Sales

Engage supporters and increase revenue with built-in revenue enhancers.

Learn more

Text to Donate and SMS

Engage donors instantly with mobile giving and scheduled messages.

Learn more

A true partner for your nonprofit organization

From implementation to support and integrations, Momentive is a true partner for your team.

GiveSmart Integrations

Unlock more donor value with GiveSmart’s integrations for your CRM, event tools, and reporting. Connect your data, streamline workflows, and elevate donor experiences without extra effort.

Learn more

RESEARCH STUDY

Weathering Federal Uncertainty: Nonprofit Operational Trends

How top-performing nonprofits grow revenue through optimism, flexibility, and futureproofing.

Download now

FAQ

Accelerate your fundraising efforts and propel your mission forward

Discover how Momentive's fundraising solutions can help your organization achieve and exceed its goals.

Request a Demo
Speak With Us
