item.content:encoded:
Nonprofit Ticketing Software

Bring on Better Ticketing and Guest Management

Offer cohesive experiences that start before the first hello. From ticket purchase to check-in and checkout, GiveSmart streamlines every step of your event. Whether you’re hosting a gala, 5K, or golf tournament, our ticketing and guest management tools deliver a smooth experience for attendees and a simpler, smarter process for your team.

Get started with GiveSmart

Benefits

Simplify event logistics and wow your guests

GiveSmart helps you eliminate the stress of managing guest logistics while elevating your event from start to finish. Simplify ticket sales, reduce lines, and deliver a memorable experience that keeps supporters coming back. 

Features

Better fundraising event organization from start to finish

GiveSmart’s ticketing and guest management features empower your team to deliver a professional, polished experience while gaining insights that improve every future event.

Integrated Ticketing Platform

Smarter ticketing for higher event revenue

Create and manage tickets with dynamic pricing, promo codes, and group options that are all built into your fundraising event page.

Contactless Check-In

Fast, easy, and frustration-free

Allow your guests to skip the line and check in from their mobile phones with a simple link, so they can get on to the fun and giving.

Unified Guest Data

Connected reporting for smarter follow-up

Track attendance, donations, and bidding activity in one central database for post-event reporting, outreach, and stewardship.

Seating Management

Take the stress out of seating and guest details

Assign seats, tables, golf foursomes, and other group guests and have a quick view of custom preferences like meal selection for smooth coordination and an elevated guest experience.

Efficient Checkout

Close out your event with ease

Automate post-event payments, send receipts instantly, and access reports to close out your event faster than ever.

Request a Demo

Connect More. Manage More. Raise More.

GiveSmart by Momentive Software connects organizations with donors on an engaging, modern, all-in-one fundraising solution. Bring on better for your organization’s mission.

Explore more fundraising solutions

View All

item.title: Fundraising - Raffles, Voting, and Item Sales
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Raffle Software

Turn every interaction into an opportunity to give.

With GiveSmart, fundraising can be as fun as it is effective. Add raffles, voting contests, and instant-buy items as revenue enhancers to your events or campaigns to energize donors. Bring on better engagement — and bring in more support.

Get started with GiveSmart

Benefits

Bring on better engagement. Bring on better fundraising.

GiveSmart’s raffles and item sales features help nonprofits blend excitement with generosity. Whether you’re rewarding participation, encouraging friendly competition, or driving impulse giving, these interactive tools turn enthusiasm into real impact.

Features

Bring on better tools that inspire generosity and excitement.

GiveSmart’s raffle, voting, item sales, and other revenue-enhancing tools help you create dynamic donor experiences that drive both participation and profit.

Raffle Management Tools

Simple setup,  powerful results

Create and manage digital raffles and games of chance with automated ticketing, random drawings, and instant winner notifications. Effortless raffle management better supports your staff and volunteers.

Voting Campaigns

Let your audience have a say

Set up donation-based polls or competitions— such as “vote for your favorite pet” or “choose the best dish” — to encourage micro-giving with every vote. Adding a voting competition to any of your fundraisers adds excitement, fun, and funds.

Instant-Buy Item Sales

Turn purchases into purpose

List merchandise, experiences, or fixed-price items that supporters can purchase instantly within your campaign page. Offering spirit wear, class parties, experiences with limited capacity, fan paddles, memberships, mulligans, and more expands giving opportunities, thereby increasing  donor engagement.  

Event Integration

Keep everything connected

Integrate raffles and item sales directly into your event registration or auction experience for one unified giving flow. Offering these as packages and add-ons allows your organization to raise more money, even before your event.

Branding and Reporting Options

Customize, track, and celebrate success

item.title: Fundraising - Campaign and Event Management
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Fundraising Event Management Software

Build, manage, and measure every event with confidence.

From galas to golf tournaments, GiveSmart gives you everything you need to plan, launch, and maximize every fundraising event.<br><br> GiveSmart lets you plan, launch, and track everything in one place. Customizable pages, built-in reporting, and live dashboards help you bring on better events for your mission.

Get started with GiveSmart

Benefits

Bring on better control. Bring on better results.

GiveSmart’s charity event software simplifies your fundraising campaign management. Make running your galas, auctions, and walks easier so your team can focus on strategy and impact. Monitor engagement in real time and adjust with confidence — all from one platform.

Features

Bring on better tools to power every event.

GiveSmart makes campaign and event management intuitive and adaptable, helping you create polished experiences that grow engagement and revenue, without overloading your staff.

Custom Campaign Pages

Tell your story, your way

With GiveSmart’s fundraising event platform, design campaign pages with flexible layouts, videos, images, and goal trackers. Strengthen recognition and donor trust with our tools that enable you to easily keep colors, logos, and tone consistent across all fundraisers. Add fully customizable ticketing, registration, and order forms to increase donor conversion  and engagement.

Sponsor Activation

Elevate sponsor engagement and exposure

Sponsor activation in GiveSmart’s gala fundraising software monetizes your auction, voting competition, raffle, or merchandise store, helping you showcase your sponsors, adding value, and increasing the return on their partnership with your organization.

Real-Time Fundraising Event Analytics

Measure what matters most

Track donations, attendance, bids, and engagement to make informed adjustments during campaigns with our event fundraising tools for nonprofits. With GiveSmart’s multi-campaign dashboards, you can best monitor all campaigns with one view.

Automated Reporting and Exports

Save hours of manual work

Generate ready-to-share reports for boards, finance teams, or stakeholders with a single click. With GiveSmart’s robust reporting, you and your stakeholders can better strategically plan for your mission’s future.

Fundraising Thermometer and Donor Recognition

Celebrate donors and  spark more giving

Use a live-event fundraising thermometer to showcase donations in real time and inspire “in the moment” giving. GiveSmart’s individual recognition features help you highlight major donors, while celebratory animations after winning bids bring extra excitement and keep the energy high.

Helping associations build better results

item.title: Fundraising - Peer-to-Peer Fundraising and Crowdfunding
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
P2P Fundraising

Turn your peer-to-peer supporters into storytellers

GiveSmart’s peer-to-peer and crowdfunding tools make it easy for donors, teams, and communities to fundraise for your cause with confidence. Bring on better community.

Get started with GiveSmart

Benefits

Bring on better reach. Bring on better relationships.

Empower supporters to build their own campaigns, share personal stories, and inspire others to give. GiveSmart helps you harness the power of connection to expand your mission’s impact.

features

Better tools that grow your community and your revenue

With customizable pages, integrated sharing tools, and live leaderboards, GiveSmart’s peer-to-peer and crowdfunding platform blends creativity, connectivity, and accountability, so every campaign inspires action.

Personal and Team Fundraising Pages

Empower fundraisers at every level

Supporters can launch branded pages, set goals, and drive traffic with personalized keywords. This will allow their pages  to share their messages while staying true to your organization’s preset branding and guidelines. Fundraisers can add videos  and images to help tell the story of why they are supporting  your mission.

Social and Mobile Sharing Tools

Boost reach and grow  your impact

Built-in share links and SMS tools make it simple to promote campaigns across every major channel. Social media sharing spreads awareness and connects your cause with your peer-to-peer fundraisers’ personal networks. Generosity grows when  it’s shared.

Leaderboards and Progress Meters

Fuel friendly competition

Highlight top performers to keep participants motivated and donations climbing. Track and share each peer-to-peer fundraiser’s performance towards their goal, as well as in comparison to others supporting your campaign. The ability to rank fundraisers will encourage further competition.

Built-In Donation Processing

Fast, secure, and seamless donor experiences

Donors can contribute directly on participant pages without switching platforms or losing momentum. Autogenerated receipts and tax letters acknowledge your donors’ generosity nearly instantly. You can feel confident that your donor data  is secure and private with our PCI- and SOC 2-compliant system, too.

Campaign Analytics and Insights

See what’s driving success

Track participation rates, average gift size, and total raised in real time to refine strategy and celebrate results. See the reporting at a glance and manage the backend from anywhere.

A true partner for your organization

From implementation to ongoing support and training, Momentive is with you every step of the way.

Implementation Services

Gain access to a dedicated team that handles implementation, optimization, and ongoing growth.

Our Solutions

Career center software that fits  your organization

Employ a suite of solutions that empower organizations to do more, connect more, and create organizational success. Meet the tools that fit your organization:

Text to Donate and SMS

Engage donors instantly with mobile giving and scheduled messages.

Learn more

Auctions and Mobile Bidding

Power seamless auctions from anywhere with accessible tools.

Learn more

Online Giving and Payments

Boost donor loyalty and simplify giving with our forms, payments, and features.

Learn more

Ticketing and Guest Management

Create stress-free events with seamless check-in, seating, and checkout.

Learn more

Fundraising – GiveSmart Integrations

Learn more

Custom Forms

Streamline donations, sales, and  sign-ups with our flexible forms.

Learn more

Fundraising – Raffles, Voting, and Item Sales

Learn more

Fundraising – Campaign and Event Management

Learn more

Fundraising – Peer-to-Peer Fundraising and Crowdfunding

Learn more

Request a demo

Connect More. Manage More. Raise More.

GiveSmart by Momentive Software connects organizations with donors on an engaging, modern, all-in-one fundraising solution. Bring on better for your organization’s mission.

Explore more fundraising solutions

View All

item.title: MomentiveIQ
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
MomentiveIQ

Meet our new AI-powered platform designed specifically for nonprofits and associations to unify their technology ecosystem into an intelligent experience that delivers personalized engagement and actionable insights.

Speak with an expert

Innovation Built for Nonprofits and Associations

MomentiveIQ is an intelligent, unified platform that automates workflows, delivers personalized user experiences, and provides predictive insights across your entire ecosystem.
MomentiveIQ’s advanced technology provides:

  • AI Agents that automate workflows and user interactions
  • AI-driven analytics surfacing predictive trends and opportunities
  • Personalized experiences tailored to each user journey
  • Industry-specific integrations with best-in-class security and governance

What you get

Unify your systems. Elevate member and donor value.

We created the most comprehensive and integrated mission-driven platform in the market to deliver a seamless, end-to-end customer experience powered by advanced analytics along with AI-driven recommendations.​

Features & Capabilities

One intelligent experience

With MomentiveIQ, you get real-time data, intuitive dashboards, and a 360° view of engagement without the headaches of managing complex systems. 

AI Analytics

Turn data into decisions with AI-powered insights that unify your ecosystem with interactive dashboards and charts that make complex data easy to understand and act upon.

Integrations & APIs

Connect everything effortlessly with pre-built connectors and APIs, enabling easier integrations between both your current Momentive products and third-party applications to reduce manual processes and eliminate data silos.

AI Agents

Leverage our intelligent workforce that automates workflows and anticipates future outcomes, to deliver personalized suggestions to drive smarter decisions and personalized experiences.

Comprehensive Portal

Create personalized experiences for members, donors, learners, and attendees through configurable dashboard widgets that centralize multi-product interactions while helping staff save time and drive engagement.

Widget Library

Clients are able choose widgets from a centralized library of multi-product interactions that can be displayed in a dashboard view along the admin, donor, learner, volunteer, or member journey.

item.title: Donor Management Software
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Donor Management Software

Bring on Better
Donor Stewardship

Do more with our smart, modern donor management software and a partner invested in your success.

Speak with an expert

Helping thousands of nonprofits and other organizations track, manage, and steward their donors.

Join thousands of organizations creating impactful events with Momentive.

Make your mission a movement with our donor management software

Gain access to all our donor management tools, from donor search and dashboards to automated thank yous, easy gift entry, and everything in between, so you can better engage your donors.

What You Get

Donor management tools that work together 

Simplify retention, thank donors the right way, and gain visibility with GiveSmart. Our donor management tools and features equip your team to engage your supporters year-round and keep them giving.

Helping organizations connect more

0%

donor retention when donors are thanked within 24 hours

0

annual, automated e-mail campaigns powered

OUR Donor Management SOLUTIONS

Donor management software that supports your mission

GiveSmart’s donor management tools help you do more. Donor CRM’s clean, customizable interface, Gift Entry Wizard, grouping, follow-up scheduling, and additional automations help your team connect with your supporters more effectively.

A trustworthy partner for your nonprofit organization

From fundraising to support and integrations, Momentive is a true partner for your team.

GiveSmart Donor CRM Integrations and Consolidation

With Donor CRM, you’re part of the GiveSmart ecosystem — Fundraise, Events, and Donor CRM — under one contract, one login, and one trusted partner. Connect data between fundraising, event, and donor systems with an automated daily sync of donor and giving data.

Learn more

RESEARCH STUDY

Weathering Federal Uncertainty: Nonprofit Operational Trends

How top-performing nonprofits grow revenue through optimism, flexibility, and futureproofing.

Download now

item.title: Donor Management and Retention
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Donor Retention Software

Build stronger relationships. Create lasting impact.

GiveSmart Donor CRM simplifies donor management with modern, intuitive tools that help you understand, engage, and retain your supporters. Every interaction is tracked in one place — turning data into meaningful action and long-term loyalty.

Get started with GiveSmart Donor CRM

Benefits

Bring on better donor relationships. Bring on better results.

GiveSmart Donor CRM empowers you to focus less on administration and more on connection. By keeping donor data organized and actionable, your team can personalize outreach, improve retention, and inspire greater generosity.

Features

Bring on better tools that make donor management effortless.

GiveSmart Donor CRM brings together everything you need to steward supporters and sustain growth — with flexible configuration, built-in intelligence, and user-friendly design.

Centralized Donor Profiles

See every detail, all in one place

Access donation history, pledge records, interactions, group involvement, and contact details from one easy-to-navigate record view. These insights encourage relationship building with individual donors, strengthening your mission and impact.

Smart Donor Score and DonorSearch Integration

Discover capacity at a glance

Quickly identify high-affinity donors with the DonorSearch scoring system, which measures both giving potential and engagement. From within each donor’s profile, instantly view estimated giving capacity and philanthropic history using the tools included in every subscription.

Pledge Tracking and History

Stay on top of every commitment

Manage installment schedules, pledge fulfillment, and payment progress in real time. You can also easily track multi-payment pledges, gifts of stock or property, and in-kind services with Donor CRM, ensuring your organization captures every gift.

Customizable Database Structure

Design your CRM for your mission

Use custom fields, tagging, and our dynamic Households & Groups tools to capture the data that matters most to your organization. You can build filters and segments that help your team discover hidden donor potential and wealth capacity.

Request a demo

Connect More. Manage More. Raise More.

GiveSmart by Momentive Software enables organizations to better manage donors on an intuitive, modern donor management solution. Bring on better for your organization’s mission.

Explore more donor management solutions

View All

item.title: Donor - Gift Tracking and Acknowledgment
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Donor Tracking Software

Every gift recorded. Every donor recognized.

GiveSmart Donor CRM helps your team confidently track gifts, pledges, and acknowledgments—making stewardship faster, easier, and more personal. From entry to thank-you delivery, every step stays connected and organized.

Get started with GiveSmart Donor CRM

Benefits

Bring on better accuracy. Bring on greater gratitude.

GiveSmart Donor CRM automates the details of giving management so your staff can focus on relationships, not reconciliations. With efficient tracking and acknowledgment tools,  honor every gift promptly and maintain complete confidence in your records.

Features

Bring on better tools that simplify giving management.

GiveSmart Donor CRM delivers everything you need to record, reconcile, and recognize gifts in one intuitive platform.

Gift Entry Wizard

Capture gifts quickly and accurately

Record donations with guided steps that ensure complete, error-free data entry for every transaction.

Automated Thank-You Letter

Show gratitude instantly

Create personalized acknowledgment letters that are automatically generated and tracked for each donor.

Pledge and Adjustment Tracking

Monitor every commitment with precision

Track pledges, installments, and adjustments in real time to maintain up-to-date giving records. Our tools make it easy to track multi-payment pledges, gifts of stock or property, and in-kind services.

Export and Sharing Options

Share insights seamlessly

item.content:encoded:
Donor Reporting Software

See your data clearly. Act on it confidently

Better decisions start with better insights. GiveSmart Donor CRM provides dynamic dashboards, flexible reporting, and advanced filtering so you can measure what matters most-donor retention and giving trends—all in one place.

Get started with GiveSmart Donor CRM

Benefits

Bring on better insights. Bring on better decisions.

GiveSmart’s reporting tools transform raw data into actionable intelligence. From visual dashboards to detailed queries, your team gains the clarity to understand progress, identify opportunities, and demonstrate impact with confidence. 

Features

Bring on better tools that make your data work harder. 

GiveSmart Donor CRM’s analytics suite delivers clarity, speed, and depth, so every team member can access the insights they need, when they need them.

Informative Dashboards

Stay informed at a glance

Monitor donor retention, average gift size, and donation trends in one visual dashboard. Our dashboard makes tracking simple, so you can easily measure success and opportunities.

Advanced Filtering and Querying

Zero in on what matters

Use powerful inverse filtering and multi-layered queries to find and segment records quickly. With our unique custom date selection capability, you can track trends beyond the usual annual or year-over-year time periods to meet your specific needs.

Built-In Inquiries and Template

Save time with preconfigured report

Start with ready-to-use report templates that capture key donor management insights right out of the box, with the reports you use often, like LYBUNT and other lapsed donor reports.

Export and Sharing Options

Share insights seamlessly

Generate reports in multiple formats for presentations, internal reviews, or accounting documentation. A secure, one-click, simple share option makes it easy for your staff and board to get the need-to-know. 

Daily Data Sync

Make confident, data-driven decisions

See updates daily as donor and gift data are synced from GiveSmart Events and Fundraise automatically—no manual refresh required. Break down silos and increase efficiency, giving you more time to steward your donors. 

Our Solutions

Employ a suite of solutions that empower organizations to do more, connect more, and create organizational success. Meet the tools that fit your organization:

item.title: Donor - Donor Engagement and Stewardship
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Donor Engagement Software

Build trust. Nurture loyalty. Inspire continued giving.

Strong donor relationships are built on meaningful engagement. GiveSmart Donor CRM helps your team track interactions, schedule follow-ups, and personalize outreach, strengthening trust and growing long-term support with every interaction.

Get started with GiveSmart Donor CRM

Benefits

Bring on better engagement. Bring on better loyalty.

With GiveSmart Donor CRM, you can plan intentional stewardship strategies that make every donor feel seen and valued. Track relationships, log activities, and organize communications to drive higher retention and lifelong advocacy.

Features

Bring on better tools that turn gratitude into growth.

GiveSmart Donor CRM centralizes every engagement detail, helping your team deliver consistent, personalized stewardship experiences that deepen donor trust.

Activity Tracking and Scheduling

Keep your team aligned and proactive

Log every donor touchpoint, assign follow-ups, and view a shared history to maintain consistent communication. Simple soft credits tracking enables accurate donor recognition. At the same time, the tools for tracking multi-payment pledges, gifts of stock or property, and in-kind services ensure you are up to date on all donor support data.

Donor Profiles and Communication History

Know your donors, inside and out

Access each supporter’s full journey—from first gift to latest interaction—on a single, intuitive record. Our Households & Groups tool offers a comprehensive view of your donors, including individuals, families, organizations, and other groups. With assignable roles and relationships, your records come to life and reveal the story behind the numbers.

Task and Reminder System

Stay organized, stay connected

Create tasks and automated reminders to ensure timely follow-ups and outreach consistency across your team. Consistent touchpoints enhance your relationships with your supporters.

Custom Stewardship Plans

Build engagement that lasts

Using custom fields and tags helps your team discover hidden donor potential and wealth capacity. Then, design and send personalized e-mail communications directly from the platform with the built-in e-mail tool to increase retention.

Our Solutions

Career center software that fits  your organization

Employ a suite of solutions that empower organizations to do more, connect more, and create organizational success. Meet the tools that fit your organization:

item.title: Donor - Data and Segmentation Tools
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Donor Segmentation & Personalization

The right data. The right message. The right moment.

Personalized outreach begins with powerful data. GiveSmart Donor CRM gives your organization complete control over donor records, segmentation, and search—helping you deliver targeted campaigns that deepen connection and drive engagement.

Get started with GiveSmart Donor CRM

Benefits

Bring on better data. Bring on better relationships.

When your data is organized and actionable, you can reach donors more effectively and communicate with precision. GiveSmart’s segmentation tools help you create meaningful, tailored experiences that inspire giving and long-term loyalty.

Features

Bring on better tools that turn information into impact.

GiveSmart Donor CRM makes segmentation and search intuitive, empowering your team to use data to get ahead rather than play catch-up. 

Elastic Search Technology

Find what you need instantly

Search across multiple fields simultaneously to locate records or recent gifts quickly, even with incomplete or misspelled queries. Navigate large volumes of data with ease.

Custom Fields and Tags

Organize data your way

Create and manage custom attributes to fit your organization’s programs, campaigns, and donor relationships. Custom fields and tags help you discover hidden donor potential and wealth capacity.

Households & Groups

Understand giving at every level

Gain a clearer, more flexible way to organize donor data—while saving your staff valuable time. Easily link related donors to view household giving totals, social or affinity groups, or business connections, and manage shared communications with confidence.

Advanced Query Builder

Segment with precision

Use filtering and inverse filtering tools to build hyper-targeted lists for outreach and analysis, and create multi-level queries in plain English without the need for complicated query lingo. Get the commonsense answers you need to drive giving. 

Export and Sync Options

Keep every system aligned

item.title: GiveSmart Donor CRM Integrations and Consolidation
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Donor CRM Software

One platform. Unified data. Limitless impact.

GiveSmart Donor CRM connects every part of your fundraising ecosystem—events, online campaigns, and donor management. With automated syncing and secure infrastructure, you can manage everything under one contract, one login, and one trusted partner.

Connect with our donor management experts

Benefits

Bring on better unity. Bring on better efficiency.

GiveSmart eliminates the silos that slow down your mission. By integrating fundraising, event, and donor data, your team gains a complete picture of engagement and performance, all while saving time and reducing complexity.

Integrations

Bring on better tools that connect your entire mission.

GiveSmart Donor CRM serves as the core of an integrated ecosystem, linking your donor management, fundraising, and event operations. Reduce complexity (and cost) with one vendor for your fundraising and donor management needs.

Automated Daily Data Sync

All your donor activity, in one place

Experience automatic updates of donor and giving data from GiveSmart Fundraise and Events into Donor CRM. Access unified donor records that reflect contributions, event participation, and communication activity.

Integrated Reporting

View full impact at a glance

Pull organization-wide insights that combine data from every GiveSmart module to measure engagement, giving, and growth.

Automatic Record Updates

Always stay current

Changes to donor data, event activity, or transactions are updated automatically —no double work required. GiveSmart’s automatic data flow and synced activities break down silos  and increase efficiency, giving you more time to steward  your donors.

Helping organizations connect more

0%

donor retention when donors are thanked within 24 hours

0

Annual, automated e-mail campaigns powered

Request a demo

Connect More. Manage More. Raise More.

GiveSmart by Momentive Software enables organizations to better manage donors on an intuitive, modern donor management solution. Bring on better for your organization’s mission.

Explore more donor management solutions

View All

item.title: School Accounting Software
item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
School Accounting Software

School Accounting Software Built for Your Institution

Purpose-built school fund accounting software for managing federal funding, compliance requirements, and lean finance teams. Trusted for 40+ years.

Get started

Benefits

Compliance. Security. Transparency. Always.

Be audit-ready with MIP Accounting’s robust audit suite. From our built-in audit trail to internal controls and view-only licenses, we give your organization the tools to ace your financial audits.

Features

Everything your school finance team needs in one platform.

Purpose-built platform for the funding structures, compliance requirements, and reporting obligations of school finance.

Fund and Grant Accounting

The structure that federal funding requires

Mixing categorical funds, federal grants, and general operating dollars creates an audit risk. MIP Accounting’s segmented chart of accounts keeps every fund separate and traceable, with validation rules that enforce correct coding at the point of entry. GASB-compliant financial statements and federal expenditure reports generate directly from the system.

Budget Management

Built for school year cycles, grant periods, and everything in between

District budgets don't follow a simple annual cycle. Grant periods overlap fiscal years, categorical funds expire on federal timelines, and mid-year adjustments are constant. Build unlimited budgets across any time frame, enforce spending controls by fund, and run what-if scenarios when state funding shifts or enrollment projections change.

Financial Reporting and Insights

Every report your district requires

From Schedule of Expenditures of Federal Awards (SEFA) to per-pupil expenditure reports to fund-by-fund board presentations, Momentive's 150+ built-in templates cover the full range of education reporting requirements. Build custom reports for your district's specific needs, Drill Down to transaction-level in seconds, and automate delivery to administrators, board members, and state agencies.

Accounts Payable and Automated Payments

Vendor payments that don't create audit exposure

Momentive Automated Payments, powered by Corpay, processes ACH, EFT, and virtual card payments with the fund-level coding your programs require. Every payment posts automatically to the correct grant or program, with a complete audit trail from invoice to disbursement.

Payroll and HR Management

Your largest expense line, allocated correctly every time

Personnel costs are your largest budget line and the most error-prone to allocate. Momentive Software connects payroll directly to fund accounting and automatically distributes salary and benefit costs across Title I, the general fund, and special programs, eliminating duplicate entries and manual end-of-month reconciliation.

Audit-Ready Security and Compliance

Ready for federal monitors before they call

Maintain a tamper-evident audit trail across every transaction, enforce role-based access by program and fund, automate indirect cost allocation, and issue view-only licenses to your finances. When a monitor asks for documentation, your answer is a few clicks away, not a few days.

Benefits

Bring on better financial clarity for your education institution.

Fund accounting for schools involves federal grants, categorical funding, state mandates, and annual audits — all managed by a team that rarely has enough hours to do so. MIP Accounting by Momentive Software is built to handle the complexity, so your team doesn't have to.

Fund accounting flexibility built for education — track Title I, grants, and district funds separately

Stop managing Title I, IDEA, food service, and capital funds across disconnected spreadsheets. Momentive keeps every funding source separate, traceable, and compliant — in one flexible chart of accounts.

Compliance and audit readiness for federal and state requirements

Compliance with Single Audit requirements, 2 CFR Part 200, state-mandated GASB reporting, and a complete audit trail is built into every transaction, so your team walks into every audit prepared.

Board and administrator-ready reporting

150+ built-in report templates cover everything your district is required to produce, from SEFA to per-pupil expenditure reports to board presentations.

Automation for lean school finance teams

Automated payroll allocation, bank reconciliation, and vendor payment processing eliminate the manual work that costs your finance team hours every week, freeing them to focus on strategic work.

Association events come with unique demands—member pricing, AMS data sync, chapter logistics, and CE compliance. Momentive's association event software is built to handle all of it.

Benefits

Simplify member registration, AMS integration, and event reporting in one place

From small associations to established organizations, Momentive’s association events software meets you exactly where you are. Easily manage members, operations, and automations with tools built to empower your unique mission.

Features

Association event software with AMS integration, CE tracking, and effective automations

From annual conferences to chapter programs, Momentive gives association professionals the tools to manage every event type without the administrative overhead.

Event Registration

Member Registration Built for Associations

Create branded event registration pages that recognize member status in real time and automatically apply the correct pricing tier. Support multiple registration pathways for members, non-members, students, and chapter attendees. Single sign-on (SSO) and AMS membership verification reduce friction at sign-up while keeping your member data accurate.

Check-in & Badging

Fast, Branded On-Site Check-In

Make a strong first impression with streamlined check-in and badge printing designed for high-volume association conferences. On-demand badge printing eliminates pre-printed prep work and reduces wait times, even at your largest events. Staff and volunteers can check in attendees in seconds using QR code scanning or name lookup, keeping lines moving and the member experience seamless. Momentive's badge printing integrates directly with leading AMS platforms so your onsite data stays connected to member records.

Attendee Tracking

Always Know Who's in the Room

Gain real-time visibility into session attendance, engagement patterns, and member participation across your association conferences and large-scale member events with Momentive's attendee tracking tools. Track how long members stay in sessions, monitor engagement across multi-day events, and uncover popular topics by attendee type to inform future programming. Session scanning also supports CE credit awarding. Just scan attendees in and out to verify attendance time, then accurate award credits automatically update after your event.

CE Credit Claiming

Simplify CE Credit Management for Members and Staff

Continuing education credits are one of the most valuable benefits associations offer and one of the most time-consuming to administer. Momentive's CE credit claiming solution gives members a personalized web portal to claim credits, complete session evaluations, and manage enduring materials online. Reporting tools track awarded credits by user, session, and course — with board and license issuance reporting built in.

AMS Integration

Keep Member Data Connected Across Every Event

Momentive integrates with leading association management systems, including Nimble AMS, NetForum, and YourMembership, so event registration data syncs directly to member records. Member pricing, attendance history, and CE credits are all captured and reflected in your AMS without manual imports or reconciliation. This connected approach gives association professionals a complete picture of member engagement across every program on your calendar.

Reporting & Analytics

Real-Time Insights That Inform Your Strategy

Track registration volume, revenue, session attendance, and member engagement before, during, and after every event. Momentive's reporting tools give association executives and event managers the dashboards and exportable reports they need for board presentations and post-event analysis. With filtering and segmentation by membership tier, chapter, and event type, you can make confident, data-backed decisions for every program on your calendar.

item.title: Trade Show Management Software
item.content:encoded:
Trade Show Management Software

Trade Show Management Software That Runs the Whole Show

Transform your trade show experience with Momentive’s all-in-one trade show management software by A2Z. Simplify planning, exhibitor management, and attendee registration.

Request a Demo

Benefits

Streamlined trade show management from start to finish

Effortlessly manage exhibitors, sponsors, attendees, floor plans, and payments with Momentive's A2Z trade show management platform

Features

What Does A2Z Trade Show Management Software Include?

A2Z’s trade show management software helps improve efficiency and increase revenue in one connected system. From booth sales and floor plans, to on-site badging and lead capture.

Exhibitor Management

Manage exhibitors without the hassle

Manage booth assignments, exhibitor profiles, contracts, and payments from a centralized dashboard. Exhibitors complete their booth purchase and payment directly on your website via the Online Exhibitor Contracts (OEC) workflow. A dedicated Exhibitor Hub gives them a self-service space to update their profile, complete assigned tasks, and monitor their status to reduce back-and-forth with your team throughout the show cycle.

Attendee Registration

Customize your registration needs

Build custom registration flows for different attendee types using A2Z's Registration Form Builder. Conditional logic controls which questions each participant sees and which confirmation emails they receive. Support both online pre-registration and on-site check-in, and use promotional tracking codes to measure which outreach efforts are driving the most registrations and revenue.

Floor Plan & Booth Configuration

Manage the trade show floor with ease

Assign and manage booth layouts with A2Z's interactive floor plan, which displays available, occupied, and reserved booths in real time using color designations. The Booth Space Pricing Tool gives organizers complete control over pricing rules for each booth contract type (application, online reservation, or consultative sales). Meanwhile attendees can search for exhibitors and generate personalized printable walking maps — all from the event website or mobile app.

Sponsorship Sales & Management

Built for winning and retaining sponsorships

Sell sponsorships directly on your event website with Online Sponsorship Sales (OSS). A browsable Sponsorship Package Gallery lets sponsors discover and purchase opportunities filtered by price and availability. Built-in task management and customizable fulfillment forms keep deliverables on track, while upgrade and add-on opportunities let you expand sponsor investment at any point in the show cycle.

Lead Retrieval

Empower exhibitors with lead capture tools

Empower exhibitors to maximize their booth investment with A2Z's Lead Retrieval tools. Exhibitors scan attendee badges via mobile app or physical device to instantly capture prospect interactions, add notes, and apply custom qualifiers to rate lead quality. Collected lead data is accessible directly from the Exhibitor Hub immediately after each interaction, making follow-up faster and more targeted.

On-Site Check-In & Badging

Check-ins that keep the show flowing

Speed up entry with self-service check-in kiosks and on-demand or pre-printed badge printing. A2Z's Badge Builder lets you customize fonts, colors, and data fields, while Badge Preview Screens allow staff to verify and correct badge information in real time to reduce misprints and reprints before attendees even reach the front of the line.

Reporting & Analytics

Get real-time, actionable insights

Track registration volume, revenue, exhibitor activity, and session attendance through A2Z's Business Intelligence engine. Cross-event reporting lets organizers compare show performance year over year, while real-time financial dashboards give accounting teams and leadership an instant view of budgets, sales, and cash position.

Frequently Asked Questions

A2Z by Momentive handles the complexity of trade show management software so your team can focus on what matters — creating experiences that bring people back year after year.

item.title: Conference Management Software
item.content:encoded:
Conference Management Software

Conference Management Software for Events of Any Size

Momentive's conference management software gives your team the tools to handle every detail from a single platform, so you can focus on delivering an experience your attendees will come back for.

Get started

Benefits

How conference management software simplifies every stage of planning

From opening registration to closing remarks, Momentive’s conference management software simplifies every stage of planning for your team and your attendees.

features

What does conference management software include?

Conference software designed to simplify planning, enhance attendee engagement, and maximize ROI. Discover the tools that fit your conference's unique requirements.

Personalized Registration Experiences

Customized registration for every conference size

Build custom registration flows for general attendees, VIPs, press, speakers, and exhibitors—each with role-specific form fields, pricing tiers, and confirmation messaging. Event registration supports early bird pricing, group registration, promo codes, and membership-based discounts. Custom branding keeps your logo and organization colors front and center throughout the registration experience, while a mobile-responsive design ensures attendees can register from any device.

Role Management

Manage speakers, sponsors, and staff without the hassle

Conferences require unique registration paths and communication workflows for every stakeholder type and Momentive handles them all from a single platform. Create role-specific form fields and session options for attendees, speakers, exhibitors, and volunteers, with distinct confirmation messaging for each group. Speakers get a dedicated, secure portal through Agenda Builder & Speaker Management where they can upload presentations, complete required forms, and manage their own session content—reducing the back-and-forth with your planning team.

Sponsor Management

Built for packages, ROI, and retaining sponsorships

Sponsors invest in your conference to reach your audience and Momentive Event Management gives them the visibility to prove the return. Sponsors and exhibitors receive their own dedicated registration pathway with role-specific confirmation messaging, keeping their experience separate from general attendee workflows. Through the event app, sponsors get prominent placement across attendee-facing touchpoints including sponsor lists, exhibitor profiles, banner ads, and push notifications. Financial management and budget tracking within the session room and vendor management give your team visibility into sponsorship revenue.

On-Site Check-In & Badging

Check-ins that keep the show flowing

Speed up entry with mobile <a href="https://momentivesoftware.com/solutions/event-management-software/check-in-and-badging/">check-in and on-demand badge printing</a> that keeps lines moving even at your largest conferences. Staff can check in attendees in seconds using QR code scanning or name lookup, while self-service badge printing eliminates the prep work of pre-printed badges. Direct integration with your <a href="https://momentivesoftware.com/solutions/association-management-software/">AMS</a> means onsite attendee data stays connected to member records from the moment your doors open. Real-time check-in visibility gives your team a live view of arrival progress across the event floor.

Attendee Engagement & Session Management

Build an agenda your attendees will rave about

Momentive Event Management’s agenda builder gives conference administrators full control over session scheduling—balancing speaker availability, room assignments, and content across your entire program. Attendee tracking captures session-level engagement data in real time, helping you understand which topics resonate with which attendee types and informing future programming decisions. A mobile event app keeps attendees connected to the schedule, session details, and speaker information throughout the event. Momentive supports in-person, virtual, and hybrid conference formats within the same platform.

Reporting & Analytics

Get real-time, actionable insights

Track registration volume, revenue, and attendee engagement before, during, and after the event—with live dashboards that give your team visibility throughout the conference. Momentive Event Management’s reporting tools cover session attendance, check-in progress, and real-time revenue tracking across all ticket types, with exportable reports built for board presentations and stakeholder updates. After the event, attendee data supports analysis of what worked, where to improve, and how to plan smarter for next year.

Features overview

Conference management features at a glance

  • Multi-ticket types and price tiers
  • Event registration website design and branding
  • Mobile device check-in
  • Multiple conference, session and event support
  • Quick, secure credit card processing
  • Self-service portal and event inquiry page
  • Badge advertisements and sponsorships
  • Integration with registration and AMS/CRM
  • 24/7 live registration
  • Plan future sessions based on analytics
  • Track heavily attended topics
  • Track attendee behavior
  • Manage presentations, handouts, attachments, and more
  • Rate, comment, and approve proposals
  • Robust analytics and reporting

Frequently Asked Questions

Momentive Event Management is built for conferences of every size—plan and manage everything from a single platform. Request your personalized demo today.

item.dc:creator: dan
item.content:encoded:
Nonprofit Accounting Software

Nonprofit Accounting Software Built For Your Mission

Purpose-built fund accounting trusted by 6,000+ nonprofit organizations for 40+ years. Track every dollar, keep funders satisfied, and stay audit-ready with nonprofit accounting software.

Get started

Benefits

Bring on better financial clarity for your mission

When you're managing grants, donations, and program revenue in general accounting software, workarounds become a full-time job. Momentive's fund accounting solution is built for the complexity of nonprofit finance — so your team can focus on the mission.

Features

Everything your nonprofit finance team needs in one platform

Spend less time on manual processes, close your books faster, and stay audit-ready. One platform, built for the way nonprofits actually operate.

Fund and Grant Accounting for Nonprofits

Built for complexity, not workarounds

Track unlimited funds, grants, programs, departments, and cost centers using a flexible, segmented chart of accounts. Automatic inter-fund entries, predefined distributions, and validation rules keep every transaction accurate and traceable. Generate FASB- and GASB-compliant financial statements and the 990 Worksheet for federal filings, all without leaving the system.

Nonprofit Budget Planning and Forecasting

Take control of your budget

Create unlimited customized budgets, even for cross-year grant projects. Enforce budget controls with a single click, set overspend warnings before problems occur, and model what-if scenarios to support your organization's long-term financial goals.

Financial Reporting and Insights

From raw data to board-ready in minutes

Choose from 150+ dynamic, built-in report templates or build your own. Produce grant progress reports, FASB-compliant financials, and custom board packages in minutes. Schedule automated delivery to every stakeholder who needs them. And drill down from summary views to individual transaction-level details — all without leaving the report.

Accounts Payable and Automated Payments

Pay vendors without leaving your general ledger

Spend less time on tedious tasks and more time focused on your mission with Momentive Automated Payments, powered by Corpay. It integrates with your general ledger, giving you a real-time, centralized view of all vendor payments made via ACH, EFT, or virtual card.

Payroll and HR Management

One integrated system for people and finances

Connect payroll and HR directly to your fund accounting so salary and benefit costs are automatically allocated across the right funds and grants — with no duplicate data entry. Momentive keeps everything in one integrated system, reducing compliance risk and maintaining a single source of truth.

Audit Management and Financial Compliance

Compliance that doesn't depend on spreadsheets

Give auditors what they need and board members the fraud control they expect with tamper-evident audit trails across every transaction. Role-based permissions control access by program, department, or general ledger code. The Allocations Management module automates complex cost distribution across grants, eliminating the spreadsheet errors that create audit exposure.

Compliance Software

Keep Your Donors’ Data Safe and Your Organization’s Reputation Intact

Feel confident that your donor data is secure and private with a platform purpose-built for nonprofit fundraising.

Get started with GiveSmart

Benefits

Rest Easy That Your Donor Data Is Safe

The relationships you have with your donors depend on the trust they place in your organization. They trust that you’re not only good stewards of their dollars but also keeping their personal and payment information safe and private. GiveSmart is PCI and SOC 2 compliant so you can focus on your mission, not your security risks.

Features

A Complete Security and Compliance Solution for Nonprofits

GiveSmart is built on SOC 2 and PCI-compliant infrastructure, giving nonprofits the security and compliance foundation they need to protect donor data, process payments safely, and build lasting trust with supporters. Here are the features your organization can count on.

Firewall & Anti-Virus Protection

Ongoing Network Defense You Never Have to Manage

GiveSmart maintains and regularly updates firewalls and anti-virus software across our infrastructure so your nonprofit is always protected without requiring your team to lift a finger.

Encryption & Secure Data Storage

Donor Data Encrypted and Locked Down

Personally identifiable donor information is encrypted, stored securely, and accessible only by authorized personnel. We maintain meticulous records and logs of how and when any donor data is accessed or used.

Access Controls & Authorization

Only the Right People Access the Right Data

Controls are in place to prevent access by unauthorized personnel. Our system provides accurate representation of what you and your supporters can view and modify, as it relates to their personally identifiable information.

Transaction Integrity

Every Dollar Tracked from Registration to Closeout

Data processing integrity standards are enforced at every point in the transaction lifecycle—from donor registration to campaign closeout—so your financial records are always accurate and complete.

Independent Audits & Oversight

Third-Party Verification You Can Share with Confidence

Independent audits and oversight of GiveSmart’s processes and controls affirm our ongoing compliance with PCI and SOC 2 standards, giving you documentation you can confidently share with donors, board members, and regulators.

Vulnerability Testing & Patch Management

Continuous Security Testing Keeps Threats Out

We perform regular updates, patches, and tests for vulnerabilities across all security measures—so any potential weaknesses are identified and addressed before they can impact your organization.

A true partner for your organization

From implementation to ongoing support and training, Momentive is with you every step of the way.
